paper.title: Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents
paper.abstract: Terminal agents are a compelling application of large language models (LLMs), with the potential to integrate deeply into users' daily workflows. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a key technique for improving their capabilities, making scalable training environments a central challenge. Since public real-user interaction data are scarce, synthetic environments provide a practical alternative, but often suffer from domain gaps and limited fidelity, leading to poor generalization. Existing work main

summary.core_problem: 在合成 terminal 环境上做 RL 训练时，为什么“扩大环境覆盖面”并不必然带来跨域泛化？RL 在 terminal agent 里到底学到什么（技能 vs 行为）？以及如何用更高质量的奖励/验证信号，让较少的环境也能带来更好的 RL 效率与泛化。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练是间接相关，但对 pretrain↔posttrain 闭环很实用：它把 terminal-agent 的泛化拆成“原子技能（多由 pretrain/SFT 提供）”与“高层行为（多由 RL 塑形）”，并把环境质量问题具体化为 verifier/reward integrity，而不是只谈任务多样性。对做持续 mid-train、SFT 数据配比、以及 agentic RL 训练配方的人，启发在于：如果 RL 主要在学行为路由与协调，那么训练环境的关键资产是能稳定约束这些行为的验证器；低质量 verifier 会把 RL 推向 reward hacking 或学到不可迁移的捷径。论文给出一个工程上可落地的过滤+正则流程，并报告在显著减少环境数量时仍能提升泛化与样本效率。
summary.technical_approach:
提出“agentic compositional generalization”假设：terminal agent 能力分两层——低层原子技能（执行命令、编辑文件、基础工具使用、局部知识）与高层可复用行为（分解任务、规划、检查与纠错、在技能间路由与协调）。假设认为：SFT/预训练先验主要补齐技能，RL 主要通过奖励信号塑造高层行为；跨域泛化依赖于技能覆盖 + 行为可复用。

在该解释框架下提出 River（Reward-Integrity Verified Environments for RL）：核心不是继续扩环境数量，而是提升“奖励信号质量”。做法包括两类：
1) verifier-aware filtering：过滤掉低质量/不可靠的合成环境（奖励与真实成功不一致、可被投机、或反馈噪声大），用更少但更“干净”的环境训练。
2) behavior-level regularization：在训练中加入面向行为层的正则，约束/鼓励某些可迁移的决策模式（文中表述为提升 verifier 质量并抑制投机行为；具体正则形式与实现细节需要结合方法章节逐条看）。

整体 recipe 强调分工：技能缺口用 SFT/数据补，RL 不要指望从稀疏回报里学细碎技能；RL 资源集中用来学高层策略与自我校验行为。
summary.experiments: 作者报告 River 只用不到 30% 的 TMax 训练环境，但在多个维度上提升 RL 增益与泛化：在 Terminal-Bench-Lite 上平均 RL 增益提升 106%，在 Terminal-Bench-v2.1 上平均提升 30%；覆盖 2B–27B 不同规模模型、不同 agent harness 与不同 RL 算法下结论一致。论文还声称做了较系统的学习动态分析，用以支持“RL 学行为、SFT 学技能”的分解（具体图表与定量证据需要在实验章节核对：例如技能探针、行为分类统计、跨域迁移曲线、以及过滤/正则的消融）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先读 Introduction 把问题定义成“覆盖 vs 信号质量”；再读机制解释部分（agentic compositional generalization）看它如何把 SFT 与 RL 的作用拆开；然后直接看 River 的 pipeline（过滤标准、verifier 设计/校验、正则项是什么、训练时如何接入）；最后看实验里最关键的三类证据：1) 少环境仍更好（效率）；2) 跨 benchmark/规模/算法的稳健性（泛化）；3) 过滤与正则的消融（因果性）。预计 60–90 分钟能完成高质量泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: In RL post-training for terminal agents using synthetic environments, why does scaling environment coverage alone fail to yield robust out-of-domain generalization, what does RL actually learn (skills vs behaviors), and how can higher-integrity reward/verifier signals make training more sample-efficient and more generalizable with fewer environments.
summary_en.importance: Indirectly related to pretraining, but highly relevant to the pretrain↔posttrain interface for agentic models. The paper operationalizes the environment-design problem as reward/verifier integrity rather than sheer task diversity, and argues that RL mainly shapes reusable high-level behaviors (planning, routing, verification, recovery) while SFT/pretraining priors supply many low-level atomic skills. For practitioners, the practical value is a concrete filtering + regularization recipe that reduces environment count yet improves RL gains and generalization, and a warning that low-quality verifiers can drive reward hacking or brittle shortcuts that do not transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Proposes the “agentic compositional generalization” hypothesis: terminal-agent competence is hierarchical, with (i) low-level atomic skills (command execution, file edits, tool usage primitives, domain snippets) and (ii) high-level behaviors that compose and coordinate those skills (task decomposition, planning, verification, error recovery, skill routing). The hypothesis claims SFT (plus pretraining/mid-training priors) primarily equips skills, while RL primarily shapes high-level behaviors via reward signals; generalization requires both skill coverage and reusable behaviors.

Based on this, introduces River (Reward-Integrity Verified Environments for RL), focusing on reward signal quality:
1) Verifier-aware filtering: discard synthetic environments with unreliable or easily exploitable reward/verifier signals, keeping a smaller but cleaner subset.
2) Behavior-level regularization: add training-time regularization targeted at behavior patterns to improve verifier alignment and suppress opportunistic strategies (the exact form should be checked in the method section).

The overall recipe is a division of labor: use SFT/data to fill missing atomic skills; spend RL budget on shaping high-level decision-making and self-check behaviors rather than learning fine-grained skills from sparse terminal rewards.
summary_en.experiments: Reported results: using <30% of TMax training environments, River yields larger RL gains—on average +106% on Terminal-Bench-Lite and +30% on Terminal-Bench-v2.1—across model sizes from 2B to 27B, across different agent harnesses, and across RL algorithms. The paper also claims extensive analyses supporting the skills-vs-behaviors decomposition and includes ablations for filtering and regularization; the exact quantitative probes and plots should be verified in the experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan: read the introduction for the framing (coverage vs reward integrity), then the compositional generalization mechanism section to understand the skills/behaviors split, then jump to the River pipeline details (filtering criteria, verifier design, regularizer, how it plugs into RL). In experiments, focus on (i) fewer environments but better outcomes, (ii) robustness across scales/algorithms/harnesses, and (iii) ablations isolating filtering vs regularization. ~60–90 minutes for a solid skim.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 研究员的价值在于它把 RL 的增益解释成“行为路由”而非“新技能写入”；先看假说和消融，若 setup 干净，值得迁移到 tool-use post-train 设计。
recommendation.en: Useful because it reframes RL gains as behavior routing rather than new skill acquisition; read the hypothesis and ablations first, and only trust it if the setup cleanly separates skills from policy.

paper.title: Every Coin Has Two Sides: On the Dual Nature of Generalization in On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, yet its generalization behavior remains poorly understood, as most studies evaluate OPD on a single domain and on benchmarks close to the training data. We present a controlled study that varies one generalization factor at a time, from in-domain distribution shifts to cross-domain transfer and the multi-teacher setting. We find that OPD transfers a teacher's reasoning b

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 on-policy distillation 的泛化行为：学生在自己的轨迹上接受教师监督后，学到的是训练题目的答案、局部任务策略，还是更宽的推理行为。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对后训练与预训练研究都有参考价值。它把 OPD 的作用从“提高某个任务分数”拆成语言迁移、推理长度迁移、跨领域迁移、同源/异源教师差异和多教师干扰几个因素。一个重要结论是，OPD 传递的不是单个问题的答案，而更像是教师的推理行为分布；但这种迁移强烈依赖 teacher 和 student 是否来自同一基座。对训练 recipe 的含义很直接：多教师蒸馏不能假设 prompt routing 会把不同教师的影响限制在各自领域内，混合比例会带来能力跷跷板。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上使用标准 OPD 设置。给定 prompt x，学生策略先生成自己的 on-policy response y，训练信号来自教师在学生实际访问到的上下文 h_t=(x,y_<t) 上的 token 分布。目标可写成 teacher 与 student 之间的 reverse KL。实际训练采用 sampled-token k1 近似，也就是 PG-style OPD：如果教师给学生采样出的 token 更高概率，该 token 被强化；如果教师概率低于学生，该 token 被压制。

实验设计不是提出新蒸馏算法，而是控制变量分析 OPD 泛化。RQ1 固定数学领域，分别改变训练题难度、评测语言和推理长度，观察英文短程数学训练能否迁移到中文数学和长程组合数学。RQ2 研究跨领域迁移，例如数学提示是否改善代码和科学，其他领域提示是否反向改善数学，并把 teacher-student 关系分成 same-origin 和 cross-origin。same-origin 指教师和学生来自同一 base model 系列，常见形式是学生为 SFT checkpoint，教师是在同一 checkpoint 上经 RL 得到的模型；cross-origin 指二者来自不同基座。RQ3 扩展到 multi-teacher OPD，考察按领域路由 prompt 是否真的能隔离各专家影响。

核心观察是：训练题的表面难度影响很小，甚至教师从未解出的题也能作为有用训练提示。这说明监督信号主要来自教师对学生轨迹中局部行为的偏好，而不是完整解答是否正确。same-origin 教师能把学生在语言、推理长度和其他领域上拉近教师水平；cross-origin 教师更多改善训练分布本身，迁移弱得多，有时不如较弱的 same-origin 教师。
summary.experiments:
提供内容中没有完整表格和具体分数，但实验覆盖多组教师和学生，包括 Qwen3-32B、Light-R1-14B、Polaris-7B/4B、OpenMath-Nemotron-1.5B/7B、JustRL-DeepSeek-1.5B 等。主要结果包括四点。

第一，在数学域内，训练题难度不是主要因素。按教师 pass rate 或学生 pass rate 划分训练题后，OPD 的迁移效果差异很小；教师解不出的题也能产生有效监督。第二，训练只使用英文短程数学，仍能改善中文数学和长程组合数学，说明 OPD 的效果不局限于训练 prompt 的表面分布。第三，跨领域迁移存在，但强依赖模型来源关系。same-origin pair 可以在多个领域把学生拉近教师，而 cross-origin pair 往往主要提升训练域，在其他域迁移有限。第四，在 MOPD 中，领域路由不能完全隔离教师效果。每个教师都会影响非目标领域，多个教师合并后出现与 mixture 相关的能力跷跷板，而不是简单叠加各领域专家能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 40 分钟。先看 preliminaries 中 OPD 与 PG-style sampled-token k1 近似，确认训练信号到底是什么。然后直接看三个 RQ 的实验图表：训练难度分桶、语言/长度迁移、same-origin versus cross-origin、以及 multi-teacher mixture。最值得细看的点是同源关系的定义和实验控制，因为这决定了结论能否迁移到自己的后训练管线。MOPD 部分适合和多专家数据配比、RL teacher 选择、持续后训练的能力遗忘问题一起读。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies what on-policy distillation actually generalizes: task answers, local fitting to the training distribution, or broader reasoning behavior transferred from the teacher.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a controlled account of OPD as a post-training mechanism. It separates several factors that are often confounded: problem difficulty, language shift, reasoning-horizon shift, cross-domain transfer, model-origin relationship, and multi-teacher routing. The central finding is that OPD transfers teacher behavior more broadly than the training prompts suggest, but the breadth of transfer depends strongly on whether teacher and student share the same base-model lineage. This has direct implications for recipe design: multi-teacher OPD cannot be treated as independent domain-wise skill injection, because each teacher affects capabilities outside its routed domain.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup follows standard OPD. For a prompt x, the student samples an on-policy trajectory y. At each context h_t=(x,y_<t), the teacher provides token-level supervision. The ideal objective is a reverse KL between student and teacher policies. In practice, the paper uses the sampled-token k1 approximation, leading to a policy-gradient style OPD objective: a sampled token is reinforced when the teacher assigns it higher probability than the student, and suppressed otherwise.

The contribution is an experimental decomposition rather than a new distillation algorithm. RQ1 keeps the domain fixed to math and varies training difficulty, evaluation language, and reasoning horizon. RQ2 examines cross-domain transfer between math, code, and science, while distinguishing same-origin teacher-student pairs from cross-origin pairs. Same-origin means the teacher and student come from the same base-model lineage, for example an SFT checkpoint and an RL-trained teacher derived from it. Cross-origin means they come from different bases. RQ3 studies multi-teacher OPD, where prompts are routed to domain-specific teachers, and tests whether routing isolates teacher effects.

The key mechanism-level result is that OPD does not require the teacher to solve the training problem. Even prompts on which the teacher never succeeds can still be useful, because the supervision is applied to the student’s visited states and encodes local teacher preferences over continuations. Same-origin teachers transfer more globally across languages, horizons, and domains. Cross-origin teachers tend to improve the trained distribution more narrowly and may transfer less than a weaker same-origin teacher.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided content does not include the full numeric tables, but it lists a diverse set of teacher models, including Qwen3-32B, Light-R1-14B, Polaris-7B/4B, OpenMath-Nemotron-1.5B/7B, and JustRL-DeepSeek-1.5B.

The reported findings are consistent across the controlled settings. First, in-domain math transfer is largely insensitive to training-problem difficulty. Bucketing problems by teacher or student pass rate does not materially change the usefulness of OPD, and unsolved problems remain useful. Second, English short-horizon math OPD improves evaluation on Chinese math and longer-horizon composed math problems, indicating that the transfer is not just surface-distribution matching. Third, cross-domain transfer exists in both directions, but the origin relationship dominates: same-origin teachers move the student closer to the teacher across domains, while cross-origin teachers mostly help the trained distribution. Fourth, in multi-teacher OPD, domain routing does not isolate influence. Mixture choices create a capability seesaw because each teacher affects other domains as well as its assigned one.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 to 40 minutes. Read the OPD preliminaries first, especially the reverse-KL formulation and the PG-style k1 sampled-token approximation. Then focus on the figures or tables for the three research questions: difficulty buckets, language and horizon shifts, same-origin versus cross-origin transfer, and multi-teacher mixture effects. The most important details are the definition of model origin and the controls used to vary one generalization factor at a time. The multi-teacher section is particularly relevant for teams using domain experts, RL teachers, or continued post-training mixtures.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided content does not identify the institutions or author list.

recommendation.zh: 师生同源性决定 OPD 跨域迁移边界这一结论直接影响蒸馏数据与教师选择策略，重点读 §3 同源 vs 异源对比实验。
recommendation.en: The finding that teacher-student origin dominates OPD cross-domain transfer directly informs distillation data and teacher selection; focus on §3 same- vs cross-origin comparisons.

paper.title: CEDAR-GRPO: Process-Aware Reinforcement Learning for General Abductive Reasoning in LLMs
paper.abstract: Abductive reasoning, often characterized as inference to the best explanation, is central to explanation under uncertainty, from everyday sense-making and investigation to scientific discovery. Yet LLM research has mostly studied abduction through narrow, task-specific benchmarks, making it unclear whether observed gains transfer beyond the benchmark family used for training or evaluation. We ask whether RL post-training can improve abduction as a transferable reasoning capability. We introduce

summary.core_problem: 论文研究溯因推理能否通过强化学习后训练成为可迁移能力，而不是只在特定 benchmark 或任务格式上提分。溯因任务包含假设生成和假设选择两种形态，已有工作通常只在单一数据族内训练和评测，难以判断收益来自通用推理改进还是表层格式适配。
summary.importance: 对预训练—后训练接口有参考价值：它显示仅用最终答案奖励的 GRPO 会遗漏推理过程结构，而加入证据覆盖、证据到解释的方向性等过程奖励，可以在未见过的任务上带来稳定迁移。这对设计推理类 RL 数据、奖励信号和过程监督有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CEDAR-GRPO，在 GRPO 中组合三类奖励：最终答案正确性，证据覆盖奖励，以及证据—解释方向性奖励。正确性使用 exact match、标签匹配或执行验证；后两者要求解释覆盖观察证据，并保持从观察到假设的溯因方向，而不是生成与证据方向不一致的说明。训练数据刻意保持领域中性、知识轻量，同时混合假设生成和假设选择任务，以降低窄领域适配的可能性。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 四个模型上后训练，并在 11 个未见过的任务上评测，覆盖假设选择、缺失事实生成、可废止推理、长上下文调查、临床推理、代码调试、因果推理和通用多步推理。相比基础模型平均提升 7.4 分，相比只使用正确性奖励的 Cor-GRPO 平均提升 2.7 分；DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 在 MuSR-Murder 上相对基础模型最大提升 30.8 分。除了被直接优化的证据覆盖和方向性，分支性、回溯、竞争假设排除、先验调用、不确定性标记等 held-out 过程指标也同步改善。消融显示 RL、两个过程奖励组件、生成与选择训练数据的组合都对迁移有贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看引言中对溯因两阶段和迁移问题的定义，再看奖励设计部分，重点理解为什么证据覆盖和方向性比单纯正确性更贴近溯因结构。随后查看跨 11 个任务的主结果表和消融表，最后浏览过程指标分析。值得深挖的是：哪些过程指标真正预测跨任务迁移，哪些只是被奖励塑形后的表面行为。预计阅读时间约 25 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether reinforcement-learning post-training can improve abductive reasoning as a transferable capability, rather than merely raising scores on a narrow benchmark family. Abduction appears in both hypothesis generation and hypothesis selection, and prior work often trains and evaluates within one task format, making it hard to separate genuine reasoning gains from format adaptation.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface because it shows that answer-only GRPO misses structural properties of reasoning. Adding process rewards for evidence coverage and evidence-to-explanation directionality yields transfer across unseen tasks, which informs reward design, process supervision, and data construction for reasoning-focused RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: CEDAR-GRPO extends GRPO with three reward terms: final-answer correctness, evidence coverage, and evidence–explanation directionality. Correctness is verified by exact match, label matching, or execution-based checks. The abductive rewards encourage explanations that account for the observed evidence while preserving the direction from observations to hypothesis. The training mixture is deliberately domain-neutral and knowledge-light, and combines both hypothesis-generation and hypothesis-selection tasks to make transfer easier to interpret.
summary_en.experiments: Four open-weight backbones are post-trained: Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Evaluation covers 11 held-out tasks spanning hypothesis selection, missing-fact generation, defeasible inference, long-context investigation, clinical reasoning, code debugging, forward causal reasoning, and general multistep reasoning. CEDAR-GRPO improves average performance by 7.4 points over base models and 2.7 points over correctness-only GRPO, with a maximum gain of 30.8 points on MuSR-Murder for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B. Beyond the directly rewarded coverage and directionality metrics, held-out process metrics such as branchiness, backtracking, differential elimination, prior invocation, and uncertainty marking also improve. Ablations indicate that RL, both process-reward components, and the mixture of generation and selection data each contribute to transfer.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction’s distinction between hypothesis generation and selection and the transfer question, then move to the reward design. The key point is why coverage and directionality capture abductive structure better than correctness alone. Next inspect the main held-out task table and ablations, followed by the process-metric analysis. A useful question to carry through is which process changes predict transfer and which are merely reward-shaped surface behavior. Estimated reading time: about 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 探索了 RL 后训练在提升通用溯因推理能力上的泛化性，其设计的 process-aware reward 值得参考。
recommendation.en: Explores the generalization of RL post-training in improving general abductive reasoning; the designed process-aware reward is worth referencing.

paper.title: Don't Claim Benchmark-Oriented Optimization Improves General Coding Capability -- Diverse Evaluation Is Required
paper.abstract: Post-training papers, model cards, and blog posts often treat scores on a small set of coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench and LiveCodeBench) as evidence of broad coding capability, both for research artifacts and user-facing systems. We argue that optimization for these benchmarks leads to measuring task-specific performance, creating a meaning gap between measured scores and claims of general coding ability. We examine this gap with a Django-based case study benchmark suite we create.   Evaluat

summary.core_problem: 当前代码大模型与编码Agent的后训练工作普遍将SWE-bench等少数基准的得分等同于"通用编码能力"，核心问题是这种评测方式存在构念效度缺陷——窄基准优化带来的提升究竟是通用编码能力的改进，还是仅为基准特定的任务专精，缺乏有效验证，基准排名也无法可靠预测模型在其他编码任务上的表现。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两点：一是需要明确区分后训练的任务专精与基座模型的通用能力增益，若用单一编码基准评估预训练迭代（如数据配比调整、训练目标修改），可能将基准过拟合误判为通用能力提升，进而误导研究方向；二是预训练阶段的编码能力评测需要引入跨任务迁移验证，避免窄基准带来的评估偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一套基于Django框架的基准测试套件，覆盖代码编辑、生成、补全三类任务，用于测试跨任务迁移性。实验对比两类模型：一类是社区公开的、针对SWE-bench轨迹做过后训练的checkpoint，另一类是作者在单个Django任务上微调的模型。核心方法是通过同域（Django）不同任务、跨基准（SWE-bench到Django/LiveCodeBench）的迁移测试，检验"基准得分等同于通用编码能力"这一假设的构念效度。
summary.experiments: 关键结果包括三点：第一，针对SWE-bench轨迹微调的checkpoint，在Django各类任务和LiveCodeBench上几乎没有提升，部分子集甚至出现性能下降；第二，在某一个Django任务上微调的模型，无法将增益迁移到其他Django任务（即使处于同一代码仓库）或LiveCodeBench，跨任务迁移性很差；第三，SWE-bench的排名与Django任务、LiveCodeBench上的相对表现相关性很低，无法可靠预测模型在其他编码任务上的强弱。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点放在Introduction部分的核心论点和关键发现摘要，预计阅读15分钟。若关注评测方法设计，可进一步查看Django基准套件的任务划分逻辑，以及文末提出的三类评测方案（前沿模型整体评估、增量研究用多任务套件、窄应用用人机协同评估）的具体内容，无需深入实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Current post-training work on code LLMs and coding agents commonly treats scores on a small set of benchmarks like SWE-bench as equivalent to "general coding capability". The core problem is a construct validity gap: it remains untested whether gains from narrow benchmark optimization reflect improvements in general coding ability or just benchmark-specific specialization, and benchmark rankings cannot reliably predict model performance on other coding tasks.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work highlights two key points. First, post-training task specialization must be clearly distinguished from base model general capability gains. Evaluating pretraining iterations (e.g., data mixture adjustments, objective changes) with a single coding benchmark can mislead research priorities by conflating benchmark overfitting with general capability improvement. Second, coding capability evaluation in pretraining requires cross-task transfer validation to avoid bias from narrow benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a Django-based benchmark suite covering three task types: code editing, generation, and completion, to test cross-task transfer. They evaluate two sets of models: publicly available checkpoints post-trained on SWE-bench trajectories, and models fine-tuned by the authors on individual Django tasks. The core methodology uses transfer tests across tasks within the same domain (Django) and across benchmarks (SWE-bench to Django / LiveCodeBench) to probe the construct validity of equating benchmark scores with general coding ability.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings include three points. First, checkpoints fine-tuned on SWE-bench trajectories show little to no improvement on Django tasks or LiveCodeBench, with performance declines on some subsets. Second, models fine-tuned on one Django task fail to transfer gains to other Django tasks (even within the same repository) or LiveCodeBench, with very poor cross-task transfer. Third, SWE-bench rankings correlate poorly with relative performance on Django tasks and LiveCodeBench, and cannot reliably predict model strength on other coding tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the core argument and key findings in the Introduction, which takes roughly 15 minutes. If interested in evaluation methodology, review the task design of the Django benchmark suite and the proposed three-pronged evaluation framework (holistic assessment for frontier models, multi-task suites for incremental research, human-in-the-loop for narrow applications). Implementation details do not require deep attention.

recommendation.zh: 戳破了当前 SWE-bench 刷榜的幻觉，证明针对特定 benchmark 的 post-training 无法泛化，提醒我们在做代码模型对齐时必须使用更广泛的 hold-out 评估集。
recommendation.en: Punctures the illusion of current SWE-bench leaderboard chasing, proving that benchmark-specific post-training fails to generalize, and reminding us to use broader hold-out evaluation sets when aligning coding models.

paper.title: CoAdapt-GUI: Joint Workflow Context and Policy Adaptation for Unseen GUI Applications
paper.abstract: Mobile GUI agents remain brittle when deployed to applications absent from source training. We study novel-app generalization under a limited target interaction budget and without target demonstrations. We introduce CoAdapt-GUI, a test-time adaptation (TTA) framework that jointly adapts structured workflow context and policy from the agent's own target-app rollouts and rewards. The workflow context retains transferable procedures, failure modes, and verification rules while excluding app-bound s

summary.core_problem: 移动GUI agent在未见过的应用上泛化能力差，测试时适应缺乏目标应用演示且交互预算有限
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出工作流上下文与策略联合适应的测试时适应（TTA）框架，无需目标应用演示
summary.technical_approach: 将工作流上下文分离为可迁移的过程/失败模式/验证规则与应用绑定细节；用task-context-matched group-relative优化更新冻结VLM上的LoRA
summary.experiments: AndroidWorld-Generalization达45.0%（Policy-Only TTA baseline 37.5%）；AndroidWorld Plus从38.6%提升至52.9%

summary_en.core_problem: Mobile GUI agents are brittle on unseen apps; test-time adaptation lacks target demonstrations and has limited interaction budget
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: joint workflow-context and policy adaptation TTA framework requiring no target-app demonstrations
summary_en.technical_approach: Separates transferable workflow knowledge (procedures, failure modes, verification rules) from app-bound source details; updates LoRA on frozen VLM via task-context-matched group-relative optimization
summary_en.experiments: 45.0% on AndroidWorld-Generalization (vs 37.5% Policy-Only TTA baseline); AndroidWorld Plus improved from 38.6% to 52.9%

recommendation.zh: GUI agent的TTA方法，工作流与策略解耦的思路对agent泛化有启发，但与pretrain无直接关系，作为agent方法备查
recommendation.en: GUI agent TTA with workflow-policy decoupling is interesting for agent generalization but has no direct pretrain relevance—keep as reference.

paper.title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) makes Multimodal Large Language Models more accurate, but the gains are brittle: simply paraphrasing a question or changing the prompt template can degrade them, which challenges reliable deployment in high-stakes scenarios like medical VQA. We trace this to two issues of the standard RL objective. First, the binary verifier conflates format with content, so the reward signal cannot tell a wrong answer apart from a misformatted one. Second, t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究多模态 RLVR 的泛化脆弱性：模型在训练时拿到可验证奖励后，遇到语义等价但表述不同的 prompt 或模板时性能会明显下滑。
summary.importance: 这对 pretrain 研究员是间接相关但有价值的，因为它暴露了后训练奖励设计中的一个老问题：reward 把格式和语义混在一起，会诱导策略学到脆弱捷径。若这一点成立，它会反过来影响如何设计 verifier、合成数据和 mid-train / RL 接口。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把问题归因于标准 RL 目标的两点缺陷：一是二值 verifier 无法区分“答案错”和“格式错”；二是训练分布过窄，导致策略对未见 prompt 变体不稳。对应地，方法上强调两件事：把 reward 中的格式约束与语义正确性解耦；并在策略优化中引入更广的语义等价 prompt 分布，以提升对 paraphrase 和模板变化的鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升数字，但明确场景是多模态 RLVR，并以 prompt paraphrase / template shift 下的泛化退化为主要评测维度。若正文包含 clean 的 in-distribution vs out-of-template 对照和 reward ablation，这篇会比一般 RL trick 更值得看，因为它在测训练信号本身的失真。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a brittleness issue in multimodal RLVR: models improve under verifiable rewards during training, yet degrade noticeably when faced with semantically equivalent prompts or different templates at test time.
summary_en.importance: This is indirectly relevant to pretraining researchers because it exposes a familiar post-training failure mode: the reward mixes formatting with semantics, encouraging brittle shortcuts. If the diagnosis is correct, it has implications for verifier design, synthetic data generation, and the pretrain-to-RL interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors attribute the problem to two flaws in the standard RL objective. First, a binary verifier cannot distinguish a wrong answer from a misformatted but semantically correct one. Second, the training distribution covers only a narrow slice of possible prompts, so the learned policy is unstable under unseen prompt variants. The proposed remedy is to separate format from semantic correctness in the reward and optimize over a broader distribution of semantically equivalent prompts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, but it clearly frames prompt paraphrase and template shift as the key generalization tests in multimodal RLVR. If the full paper includes clean in-distribution vs out-of-template comparisons and reward-design ablations, it is more informative than a typical RL trick paper because it probes distortion in the training signal itself.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看的是 reward 设计而不是多模态外壳：若实验对 template shift 控得干净，它会直接影响你怎么做 verifier、怎么写 RL 数据格式。
recommendation.en: Read this for the reward-design lesson, not the multimodal wrapper: if the template-shift setup is clean, it should change how you build verifiers and format RL data.

paper.title: Why Knowing Both Hops Is Not Enough: Understanding Two-Hop Generalization in Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can solve complex multi-hop problems yet exhibit puzzling failures on simple two-hop queries: although a model may correctly store each individual hop, it often fails to combine them. To understand the internal mechanisms of this phenomenon, we train transformers from scratch in a controlled symbolic environment. Our experiments reveal a pattern in two-hop generalization: models generalize reliably when the second hop follows the training distribution, but always fai

summary.core_problem: 解释语言模型为什么明明分别记住了两跳知识，却仍然在简单 two-hop 组合查询上失败。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，不是新模型。价值在于它把 two-hop generalization 失败拆成可定位的层间表征错配问题，而不是笼统归因于“模型不会组合推理”。这对理解预训练后知识组合、ICL 失败模式和中间表征对齐都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在受控符号环境中从头训练 transformer，构造可精确控制分布内/分布外 second hop 的 two-hop 任务。随后做 mechanistic analysis，比较不同层对实体中间表示的一致性。结论是：当第二跳仍在训练分布内时，模型会在不同上下文中为同一实体形成一致的中间表示，因此能完成组合；当第二跳 OOD 时，下层仍能构造正确中间表示，但上层读取和映射这些表示的方式依赖训练分布，导致最终失败。
summary.experiments: 实验是小规模、可控的从零训练 transformer，而非大模型 benchmark。核心对比是 second hop in-distribution 与 out-of-distribution 两种设置下的泛化差异，并通过层级表征分析给出完整解释。摘要未给出具体参数量和数据规模，但从定位上看，重点是 clean setup 而非规模。对预训练研究员来说，价值主要在机制结论，而不是结果数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why language models often fail on simple two-hop composition even when each individual hop is correctly stored.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper rather than a new model. Its value is that it localizes the failure to a layerwise representation mismatch, instead of vaguely saying the model cannot compose knowledge. That matters for understanding knowledge composition after pretraining, in-context failures, and representation alignment across layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train transformers from scratch in a controlled symbolic environment where they can precisely vary whether the second hop is in- or out-of-distribution. They then perform mechanistic analysis of entity representations across layers. The main finding is that successful generalization arises when the same entity gets a consistent intermediate representation across contexts; when the second hop is OOD, lower layers still build the right intermediate state, but upper layers decode it using distribution-specific mappings learned during training, causing failure.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use small, controlled transformers rather than frontier LMs. The key comparison is between in-distribution and OOD second-hop settings, followed by layerwise representation analysis to explain the gap. The abstract does not provide model sizes or dataset counts, which suggests the contribution is in the cleanliness of the setup and the mechanism, not in scaling results. For pretraining researchers, the mechanism is the main takeaway.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是在讲“模型不会推理”，而是在讲 upper layers 怎么把已形成的中间实体表征读坏；若你做知识组合或 latent reasoning，建议先看机制图和层分析，再决定是否复现实验。
recommendation.en: This is not another 'LLMs cannot reason' paper; it argues upper layers misread already-formed intermediate entity states. If you work on knowledge composition or latent reasoning, read the layer analysis first.

paper.title: Language Models Generalize to Human-like Word Order Preferences
paper.abstract: A central question in language acquisition is whether linguistic biases can emerge from general learning mechanisms operating over underdetermined input. Artificial Language Learning (ALL) studies have shown that human learners reliably generalize beyond the evidence provided, including by preferring scope-homomorphic noun phrase modifier orders. In this work, we investigate whether language models exhibit the same bias under similar conditions. We create a controlled learning environment in whi

summary.core_problem: 研究语言模型在完全未见过多修饰词名词短语的情况下，是否会涌现出与人类一致的scope-homomorphic修饰词顺序偏好。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，通过受控实验验证LLM从有限输入中涌现类人语言归纳偏置的现象，为理解LLM的语言习得机制提供证据。
summary.technical_approach: 构造受控学习环境，从训练语料中移除所有含多修饰词的名词短语，消除修饰词排序的直接证据；评估模型对多修饰词句子的顺序偏好，并通过名词-修饰词关联强度分析偏好来源。
summary.experiments: 覆盖三种模型规模，均一致表现出对scope-homomorphic顺序的偏好，且偏好强度随修饰词类型变化。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates whether language models exhibit human-like scope-homomorphic noun phrase modifier order preferences when never exposed to multi-modifier noun phrases during training.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis contribution; validates the emergence of human-like linguistic inductive bias in LLMs from limited input via controlled experiments, providing evidence for understanding LLM language acquisition mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a controlled learning environment by removing all multi-modifier noun phrases from training corpus to eliminate direct evidence of modifier ordering; evaluates model preferences on multi-modifier sentences, and analyzes preference sources via noun-modifier association strength.
summary_en.experiments: Across three model sizes, models consistently prefer scope-homomorphic orders despite no training exposure, with preference strength varying by modifier type.

recommendation.zh: 受控实验设计干净，验证了LM存在超越显式n-gram的抽象语言泛化，但结论符合预期，仅作认知机制研究的弱参考即可。
recommendation.en: Clean controlled experiment verifying abstract linguistic generalization beyond explicit n-grams in LMs; expected results, only useful as weak reference for cognitive mechanism research.

paper.title: On the Implicit Flatness Bias of Sharpness-Aware Minimization: A Linear Stability Analysis with Quantitative Hyperparameter Bounds
paper.abstract: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) improves generalization by seeking parameters whose loss is robust to local adversarial perturbations, but the quantitative mechanism underlying its implicit bias toward flat minima remains unclear. In particular, the perturbation radius $ρ$ is typically treated as an isolated tuning parameter, despite defining the neighborhood in which SAM measures sharpness. We analyze mini-batch SAM near an interpolating minimum through linear stability. Under local lineariz

summary.core_problem: SAM（Sharpness-Aware Minimization）对平坦极小点的隐式偏置缺乏定量机制解释，扰动半径 ρ 通常被当作孤立调参参数，而非与 batch size、learning rate 耦合的约束。
summary.importance: 原理分析/优化器理论。给出 SAM 线性稳定条件下 Hessian 最大特征值的定量上界，明确 ρ、batch size、learning rate 三者如何共同约束平坦度，对理解 SAM 在大模型训练中的作用有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在插值极小点附近对 mini-batch SAM 做线性稳定性分析，在局部线性化和梯度噪声对齐假设下证明：每个线性稳定极小点满足 λ_max ≤ ∛(bΓ/(2ρη²))，其中 b 为 batch size、η 为 learning rate、Γ 为梯度范数界。由此定量刻画 SAM 的平坦偏置。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体实验验证；为理论推导论文。结论预测更小 batch、更大 lr 或更大 ρ 将线性稳定解限制在更平坦的极小点。

summary_en.core_problem: The quantitative mechanism behind SAM's implicit bias toward flat minima remains unclear; perturbation radius ρ is typically treated as an isolated tuning parameter rather than a constraint coupled with batch size and learning rate.
summary_en.importance: Optimizer theory / mechanistic analysis. Derives a quantitative upper bound on the largest Hessian eigenvalue under SAM's linear stability condition, clarifying how ρ, batch size, and learning rate jointly constrain flatness—relevant to understanding SAM's role in large-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes mini-batch SAM near an interpolating minimum via linear stability. Under local linearization and gradient-noise alignment assumptions, proves every linearly stable minimum satisfies λ_max ≤ ∛(bΓ/(2ρη²)), where b is batch size, η is learning rate, and Γ bounds gradient norm.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental validation in the abstract; a theoretical derivation. Predicts smaller batch size, larger learning rate, or larger radius restricts linearly stable SAM to flatter minima.

recommendation.zh: ρ-lr-batch 三维约束给了可操作的定量关系，但插值极小点+线性化假设在 LLM 规模不成立；当 intuition 看公式，别直接往训练配方上套。
recommendation.en: The ρ-lr-batch bound is a useful quantitative relationship, but the interpolating-minimum and linearization assumptions don't hold at LLM scale; treat it as intuition, not a recipe.

paper.title: AOS: Adaptive Optimizer Switching via Training-State Signals for Faster Convergence and Better Generalization
paper.abstract: Single-optimizer training is a poor fit for the distinct phases of deep network optimization: adaptive methods handle noisy early gradients well but overshoot flat minima, while SGD with momentum generalizes better in the late phase but converges slowly early on.   We introduce AOS-R (Adaptive Optimizer Switching, Rule-Based), a lightweight controller that monitors six online gradient-space signals -- gradient noise scale (GNS), Hutchinson curvature trace, loss stagnation, update stability ratio

summary.core_problem: 解决单一优化器难以同时适配训练早期噪声梯度和后期平坦极小值泛化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练 recipe / 优化器控制策略。它关注 gradient noise scale、曲率、更新稳定性等在线信号，这些信号对 LLM 训练诊断有可迁移价值；但实验主要是小中型视觉分类设定，不能直接外推到大规模预训练。
summary.technical_approach: AOS-R 是 rule-based adaptive optimizer switching 控制器，在线监控六个训练状态信号：GNS、Hutchinson curvature trace、loss stagnation、update stability ratio、gradient stability index 和 loss improvement ratio。它在 AdamW、SGD with momentum、Lion 之间切换，并用 state-preserving momentum transfer 和 400-step learning-rate bridge 减少切换时的精度损伤。
summary.experiments: 在 CIFAR-100 / WRN-28x10 上，AOS-R 到达 78% top-1 需要 81 epochs，相比 AdamW 的 109 epochs 少 26%，相比 SGD-M 的 143 epochs 少 43%，相比 Lion 的 96 epochs 少 16%。摘要称在 8 个 model-dataset benchmark 中取得更好的准确率表现，但未给出 LLM 或大规模预训练实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between a single optimizer and different phases of training: noisy early optimization versus late-stage generalization in flatter regions.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a training-recipe and optimizer-control mechanism. Its use of online signals such as gradient noise scale, curvature, and update stability is relevant to LLM training diagnostics, but the empirical evidence is from small-to-mid-scale vision benchmarks rather than language-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: AOS-R is a rule-based controller that monitors six online training-state signals: GNS, Hutchinson curvature trace, loss stagnation, update stability ratio, gradient stability index, and loss improvement ratio. It switches among AdamW, SGD with momentum, and Lion, using state-preserving momentum transfer and a 400-step learning-rate bridge to avoid degradation at transition points.
summary_en.experiments: On CIFAR-100 with WRN-28x10, AOS-R reaches 78% top-1 in 81 epochs, compared with 109 for AdamW, 143 for SGD-M, and 96 for Lion. The abstract also claims the best accuracy across eight model-dataset benchmarks, but does not include LLM-scale pretraining evidence.

recommendation.zh: 信号选择比结果更值得看；若有内部小模型训练平台，可复现切换规则，但别把 CIFAR 结论外推到 LLM。
recommendation.en: The monitored signals are more useful than the headline gains; reproduce the switching rule on internal small LMs, but do not extrapolate CIFAR results to pretraining.

paper.title: Grokking on the Weight-Decay Clock: A Rate Hierarchy from Softly Broken Symmetries
paper.abstract: Delayed generalization, or grokking, remains poorly understood despite extensive empirical study. We identify an exactly solvable late-time relaxation mechanism for grokking in linear models trained with full-batch heavy-ball optimization and weight decay, together with a locally quadratic extension to nonlinear neural networks. Our analysis reveals a distinguished population-active component of the empirical null space, which we call the grokking subspace. Along this subspace, the training pred

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 grokking 的晚期动力学：为什么训练误差已经收敛后，测试误差还会在很长延迟后继续下降。作者关注的不是“存在慢时间尺度”这一点，而是哪一部分慢运动真正影响泛化，以及这个过程如何受 weight decay、学习率和 heavy-ball momentum 控制。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练的价值在训练动态和正则化理解。它给出一个可解机制：在训练集上不可见、但在总体分布上可见的参数方向，会在 weight decay 的慢恢复力下驱动晚期泛化改善。它不能直接解释大模型预训练中的所有 grokking-like 现象，因为假设包括平方损失、full-batch heavy-ball、弱正则和局部二次近似；但它提供了清晰的因果预测，例如延迟时间随 (1-β)/(ηλ) 缩放。这类结论有助于理解 weight decay、momentum 和训练后期 cooldown/annealing 对泛化尾部的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 核心几何对象是经验 Gram 矩阵 G_N 和总体 Gram 矩阵 G_pop 的核空间关系。由于 Ker G_pop 包含在 Ker G_N 中，训练集上不改变预测的方向可以分成两类：一类在总体分布上也不可见，另一类在训练集上不可见但在总体上仍然改变预测。作者把后一类称为 grokking subspace。在线性参数模型、平方损失、full-batch heavy-ball 加 coupled L2 regularization 的设置下，训练递推的 mode spectrum 可以精确求出。沿经验核空间的平移是训练损失的对称性，weight decay 软性破坏这个对称性，于是产生慢恢复动力学。论文进一步给出离散时间和连续时间的慢根表达式，并用 soft Noether law 描述慢坐标的守恒破缺；非线性网络部分只做局部二次扩展，并显式说明误差项和适用条件。
summary.experiments: 理论给出的主要时间尺度是 k_grok ≈ (1-β)/(ηλ) log(||Π_g θ_0||/ε)，其中 Π_g θ_0 是初始参数在 grokking subspace 上的分量。实验分两层验证。第一层是精确可计算的 synthetic model，不使用拟合参数，验证了 relaxation count 按 (1-β)/(ηλ) collapse；通过缩放 grokking component 且保持训练预测不变，可以得到对数形式的延迟平移；同时区分了 grokking subspace 和真正 population-null 方向的 train/test 行为；还观察到 coupled L2 与 decoupled weight decay 之间存在 factor-(1-β) 的差异。第二层是 modular addition benchmark，出现真实 delayed generalization，延迟随 (1-β)/(ηλ) 缩放，log-log 斜率为 1.01。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 35–50 分钟。先看引言中对 Ker G_N、Ker G_pop 和 grokking subspace 的定义，这是全文的主线。技术部分重点看 Theorem 4 和 Corollary 3.1，它们给出 heavy-ball + weight decay 的精确慢根和 k_grok 缩放；再看 Theorem 20，理解为什么只有 population-active empirical-null 方向贡献晚期 population risk tail。实验部分优先看 Section 7 的 synthetic intervention 和 modular addition 缩放验证。限制条件也值得看：该机制不解释无显式 weight decay 的 grokking、不解释 feature learning 产生新总体可见方向、不处理 mini-batch noise 和 adaptive optimizer。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the late-time dynamics of grokking: test loss can keep improving long after training loss has effectively converged. The central question is not whether weight decay induces a slow timescale, but which part of the post-interpolation motion affects population risk and how that motion depends on heavy-ball momentum, learning rate, and weight decay.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for training-dynamics research. It provides a solvable mechanism in which directions invisible on the training set but visible under the population distribution control the late generalization tail. The result is not a direct model of large-scale LLM pretraining, since it assumes squared loss, full-batch heavy-ball dynamics, weak regularization, and locally quadratic behavior for nonlinear networks. Still, the scaling prediction k_grok proportional to (1-β)/(ηλ) is a concrete handle on how weight decay and momentum can set late-time generalization clocks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key object is the mismatch between the empirical Gram matrix G_N and the population Gram matrix G_pop. The null spaces satisfy Ker G_pop ⊆ Ker G_N. Directions in Ker G_N do not change training predictions, but only the quotient component that remains active under G_pop can change population predictions. The authors call this component the grokking subspace. For models linear in parameters, trained with squared loss using full-batch heavy-ball optimization and coupled L2 regularization, they derive the exact discrete-time mode spectrum. Translations along the empirical null space are symmetries of the training loss; weight decay softly breaks these symmetries, producing a slow restoring dynamics. The paper also gives continuous-time and Hamiltonian interpretations through a soft Noether law, then extends the picture to nonlinear networks under a local quadratic approximation with explicit remainder assumptions.
summary_en.experiments: The main prediction is k_grok ≈ (1-β)/(ηλ) log(||Π_g θ_0||/ε), where Π_g θ_0 is the initial amplitude in the grokking subspace. The first empirical test uses an exactly computable synthetic model and verifies, without fitted parameters, the collapse of relaxation counts under (1-β)/(ηλ). It also shows logarithmic delay shifts when the grokking component is rescaled while training predictions are preserved, separates the signature of the grokking subspace from genuinely population-null directions, and confirms a factor-(1-β) difference between coupled L2 and decoupled weight decay. A modular-addition benchmark then exhibits delayed generalization with a measured log-log slope of 1.01 for the predicted scaling.
summary_en.reading_guide: Plan for a 35–50 minute skim with selective close reading. Start with the definitions of Ker G_N, Ker G_pop, and the grokking subspace. Then read Theorem 4 and Corollary 3.1 for the exact slow root and the iteration-count scaling under heavy-ball dynamics. Theorem 20 is the main generalization statement: only the population-active empirical-null component contributes to the slow population-risk tail. Section 7 is the most useful experimental part, especially the synthetic interventions and the modular-addition scaling check. The limitations are important: the mechanism does not cover grokking without explicit weight decay, feature-learning creation of new population-visible directions, mini-batch noise, abrupt accuracy jumps, or adaptive optimizers.

recommendation.zh: 从线性模型解析推导grokking的权重衰减驱动机制，给出精确缩放律，对理解优化器与正则化的交互有参考，重点看§3核心结论。
recommendation.en: Analytically derives weight-decay-driven grokking mechanism in linear models with exact scaling, useful for understanding optimizer-regularization interaction; focus on §3 core results.

paper.title: Representation Robustness Under Executable Reasoning Constraints in Large Language Models for Mathematical Problem Solving
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated on mathematical problem solving, yet prior work often treats representationally equivalent formulations as interchangeable and conflates reasoning errors with interface failures. This paper investigates representation robustness in LLM-based mathematical problem solving by systematically varying surface representations of the same underlying problems, including story problems, word-equations, symbolic equations, and isomorphic paraphrases.

summary.core_problem: LLM数学解题中，同一底层问题的不同表面表示（应用题/符号方程/同义改写）是否会导致正确率差异，即表示鲁棒性问题。
summary.importance: 原理分析类，系统揭示LLM数学能力的表面依赖性，区分了推理错误与接口失败，为预训练数据增广和评估设计提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构建数学等价问题数据集，系统改变问题的表面表示形式，包括故事题、单词方程、符号方程、同构改写四类，评估模型在直接答案生成条件下的表现。
summary.experiments: 使用 curated 的数学等价问题数据集，评估5个当代LLM；发现不同表述下正确率翻转率显著，同构改写会导致系统性性能下降，模型对表示形式高度敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether different surface representations of the same underlying mathematical problem (story problems, symbolic equations, paraphrases) cause accuracy fluctuations in LLMs, i.e., representation robustness in mathematical reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis work that systematically reveals the surface-form dependence of LLM mathematical ability, distinguishing reasoning errors from interface failures and informing pretraining data augmentation and evaluation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a dataset of mathematically equivalent problems with systematically varied surface forms: story problems, word equations, symbolic equations, and isomorphic paraphrases, and evaluates model performance under direct answer generation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 5 contemporary LLMs on a curated equivalent-problem dataset; finds nontrivial flip rates across formulations, and systematic performance regressions even under isomorphic paraphrasing, showing strong representation sensitivity.

recommendation.zh: 揭示数学问题表面表述对LLM正确率的系统性影响，对预训练数据增广有微弱参考，看摘要和结果表即可。
recommendation.en: Reveals systematic impact of math problem phrasing on LLM accuracy; weak reference for pretraining data augmentation, just read abstract and result tables.

paper.title: Differentiable Logic Programming to Mitigate Reasoning Shortcuts in Neurosymbolic Systems
paper.abstract: Neurosymbolic (NeSy) systems integrate neural networks with logical reasoning to achieve both generalization and interpretability, but recent work has shown they are susceptible to shortcut reasoning behaviors.  We propose a novel method using matrix-based differentiable logic programming to mitigate reasoning shortcuts in two phenomena: constraint satisfaction shortcuts, where constraints are satisfied without achieving the intended task, and cognition shortcuts, where biased data leads to sema

summary.core_problem: 神经符号系统存在两类推理捷径：约束满足捷径（仅满足约束未完成目标任务）和认知捷径（数据偏差导致错误概念映射），损害泛化性与可解释性
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于矩阵的可微逻辑编程方法缓解神经符号系统的两类推理捷径问题
summary.technical_approach: 基于矩阵式可微逻辑编程语义，将规则和约束统一编码到单个矩阵，结合模糊逻辑t-norm优化梯度流，实现神经输出与逻辑原子的一对一绑定
summary.experiments: 在MNIST变体数据集上开展对照实验，验证神经输出与逻辑原子的一对一grounding可显著缓解两类推理捷径现象

summary_en.core_problem: Neurosymbolic systems suffer from two types of reasoning shortcuts: constraint satisfaction shortcuts (satisfying constraints without completing the intended task) and cognition shortcuts (biased data causing incorrect concept mappings), which degrade generalization and interpretability
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a matrix-based differentiable logic programming method to mitigate both types of reasoning shortcuts in neurosymbolic systems
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on matrix-based differentiable logic programming semantics, unifies rules and constraints into a single matrix, optimizes gradient flow combined with fuzzy logic t-norms, and implements one-to-one grounding between neural outputs and logical atoms
summary_en.experiments: Controlled experiments on MNIST variant datasets verify that one-to-one grounding between neural outputs and logical atoms significantly mitigates both types of reasoning shortcuts

recommendation.zh: 神经符号领域的推理捷径研究，与当前LLM基座预训练关联较弱，仅作文献备查
recommendation.en: Neurosymbolic reasoning shortcut research, weak relevance to current LLM foundation pretraining, only for literature reference

paper.title: Lifted Representation Hypothesis in Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often answer queries by mapping individual observations to more general rule-like structures. However, it remains unclear how these structures are stored, selected, and revised. To study this process, we propose thelifted representation hypothesis: LLMs update memory through shared latent structures rather than isolated instance-level facts. This view frames lifting as an efficient use of symmetry across instances, and shattering as the refinement of coarse lifted st

summary.core_problem: 论文研究的是：LLM在学习规则与例外时，是否倾向于把多个样本压到共享的潜在“类型”表示里，而不是逐条记忆实例；以及当后续出现例外时，模型能否把原先过粗的共享表示重新拆开。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发不在于提出了新的训练方法，而在于它给“模型如何形成抽象、又为何难以修正抽象”提供了一个可操作的分析框架。这个框架把 generalization、memory editing、ICL 更新和 fine-tuning 中的例外学习放到同一视角下：如果样本梯度方向一致，模型更容易形成共享表示；但一旦早期抽象过粗，后续修正就会受到结构性阻力。对做数据配比、课程学习、持续预训练和知识编辑的人，这个视角有参考意义，因为它提示了样本顺序、规则层级和例外密度会影响模型最终形成的是“可细化的抽象”还是“难以打碎的粗类型”。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出 lifted representation hypothesis：模型会把多个观测映射到共享潜变量 H，再由 H 决定标签或后果，而不是只记 x→y 的实例映射。与普通泛化不同，这里关心的是“哪些样本被归到同一个 H 里”。当后续证据表明这个 H 太粗时，模型需要做 shattering，也就是把原先的共享类型细分成更具体、且仍然后果一致的子类型。

方法上，论文构造了受控的 exception-learning 任务，分别测试两种方向：general-to-specific，即先给一般规则再给例外，看模型能否把已有抽象打碎；specific-to-general，即先给细粒度规则再给更一般的归纳，看模型能否向上提升成共享结构。实验覆盖 in-context learning、LoRA 和 full fine-tuning 三种更新机制。理论上，作者还用梯度对齐解释 lifting 为什么会发生：如果一批样本的梯度内积整体为正，共享更新方向更高效，模型就更倾向于把它们压到同一潜在结构里。这不是严格的机制证明，但给出了一个和训练动力学相连的解释。
summary.experiments: 核心实验结论是：模型更擅长 bottom-up lifting，不擅长 top-down shattering。也就是，先看到若干具体规则，再归纳成更一般结构，通常比“先学到一个大类，再在后面加入例外并重分类型”更容易。这个现象在 ICL、LoRA、全参微调三种设定下都出现，说明它不像某一种训练范式的偶然产物，更像共享表示修正本身的难点。论文还讨论了嵌套规则和例外层级更深时，shattering failure 会更明显。若想快速把握结果，重点看不同暴露顺序下的准确率对比，以及作者如何区分“没见够例子”与“已有抽象难以重写”这两种失败来源。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读。先看 Introduction 和 Methods，把 lifting / shattering 的定义吃透，再看实验设计图，理解 general-to-specific 与 specific-to-general 的差别。随后直接看主结果图表，关注三种学习机制下是否都呈现同样趋势。若时间有限，20-30 分钟足够抓住主线。值得深挖的点有两个：一是梯度对齐解释是否能推广到真实预训练语料；二是这种“先形成粗抽象、后续难以打碎”的现象，是否能解释持续预训练或知识编辑中的顽固错误。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs tend to store observations through shared latent rule-like structures rather than isolated instance memories, and whether they can later refine an overly coarse shared structure when exceptions appear.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is conceptual rather than algorithmic. It offers a useful lens on how abstraction forms and why abstraction revision can fail. The key idea is that learning may favor shared latent structures when examples have aligned gradients, but those same shared structures become hard to revise once exceptions arrive. That has implications for curriculum design, continual pretraining, data ordering, and model editing: the final representation may depend not only on what data the model sees, but also on whether the data encourages a coarse shared type that later resists refinement.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The authors propose the lifted representation hypothesis: instead of memorizing each x→y mapping independently, an LLM often maps multiple observations into a shared latent representation H, and predicts outcomes through H. This is different from standard generalization. The focus is not only whether a rule transfers, but how examples are assigned to a common internal type in the first place.

When later evidence shows that H was too coarse, the model must perform shattering: refine the original shared type into more specific subtypes without destroying valid prior rules. To test this, the paper builds controlled exception-learning tasks with two exposure orders. In general-to-specific settings, the model first sees a broad rule and later receives exceptions; success requires shattering. In specific-to-general settings, the model first sees fine-grained cases and later benefits from forming a broader abstraction; success reflects lifting.

The study evaluates this across in-context learning, LoRA, and full fine-tuning. The paper also gives a gradient-alignment argument for why lifting is attractive during learning: if examples share positive cross-gradient interactions, a shared update direction is efficient, making a common latent structure more likely to emerge. This is not a mechanistic proof, but it ties the hypothesis to optimization dynamics in a meaningful way.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is asymmetric behavior: models are better at bottom-up lifting than top-down shattering. In other words, they more reliably build a broader abstraction from specific examples than revise an existing broad abstraction after exceptions are introduced. This pattern appears across in-context learning, LoRA, and full fine-tuning, which suggests that the difficulty is not specific to one adaptation method.

The paper further shows that shattering failures become more pronounced when the rule structure is nested or when exceptions require finer-grained retyping. A useful part of the experimental design is that it tries to separate two failure modes: lack of evidence versus inability to revise a shared internal structure. For a quick read, focus on the accuracy comparisons under different exposure orders and on the analyses that support this distinction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Read the introduction and method section first to get the definitions of lifting and shattering exactly right. Then jump to the task setup and the main result figures comparing general-to-specific versus specific-to-general exposure. After that, inspect the results across ICL, LoRA, and full fine-tuning to see whether the asymmetry is consistent.

If time is limited, 20–30 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. The two deeper questions worth keeping in mind are: whether the gradient-alignment story scales to realistic pretraining corpora, and whether this failure mode helps explain persistent errors in continual pretraining or model editing, where a model seems to cling to an earlier coarse abstraction.

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计即可；“过早 lifting + shattering failure”是可转成数据课程和 finetune 诊断的机制假设。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental setup; premature lifting plus shattering failure is a mechanism hypothesis that can inform data curriculum and finetuning diagnostics.

paper.title: Can Transformers Really Do It All? On the Compatibility of Inductive Biases Across Tasks
paper.abstract: Transformers are remarkably versatile and their design is largely consistent across a variety of applications. But are they optimal for any given task or dataset? The answer may be key for pushing AI beyond merely scaling current designs.   *Method.* We present a method to optimize a transformer architecture for a given dataset, which we use as a tool to study optimal task-specific inductive biases. This method replaces the most important non-linearities (GeLUs,;softmax) with functions learned o

summary.core_problem: Transformer 的归纳偏置（如 GeLU 和 Softmax）是否对所有任务都是最优的？
summary.importance: 提出了一种通过在保留数据上学习非线性函数来优化特定数据集 Transformer 架构的方法，揭示了不同任务对归纳偏置的特定需求，挑战了 Transformer '一招鲜' 的普遍假设。
summary.technical_approach: 将 Transformer 中最重要的非线性组件（GeLU 和 Softmax）替换为在保留数据上学习的函数。通过在不同数据集上训练这些优化后的架构，评估任务对之间归纳偏置的兼容性。
summary.experiments: 在算法玩具任务上，新架构在学习速度、分布内/外泛化和种子稳定性方面有显著提升，但高度任务特异。在代码和语言任务上，也观察到了类似的任务特异性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Rutgers University 和 University of Adelaide。

summary_en.core_problem: Are the inductive biases of Transformers (e.g., GeLU, Softmax) optimal for all tasks?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a method to optimize Transformer architectures for specific datasets by learning non-linear functions on held-out data, revealing task-specific needs for inductive biases and challenging the 'one-size-fits-all' assumption of Transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Replaces the most important non-linearities (GeLU and Softmax) in Transformers with functions learned on held-out data. Evaluates the compatibility of inductive biases between task pairs by training these optimized architectures on different datasets.
summary_en.experiments: On algorithmic toy tasks, new architectures show dramatic improvements in learning speed, in/out-of-distribution generalization, and seed stability, but are highly task-specific. Similar task specificity is observed on code and language tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Rutgers University and University of Adelaide.

recommendation.zh: 通过学习非线性激活函数来探究 Transformer 归纳偏置的任务特异性，对理解模型架构的泛化能力有一定启发，可关注其在算法任务上的实验设计。
recommendation.en: Explores task-specific inductive biases of Transformers by learning non-linear activation functions, offering insights into architecture generalization; the experimental design on algorithmic tasks is worth noting.

paper.title: UniETP: Unifying Environments for Generalizable Embodied Task Planning
paper.abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of Embodied Task Planning, where an agent is required to execute a sequence of atomic actions within an interactive environment to complete a user-specified task. Though a variety of simulators and datasets have previously been built for this task, these efforts are largely isolated, with each using its own observation format, action type, and task domain. This fragmentation complicates comprehensive model evaluation and hinders the scalability of training data.

summary.core_problem: 具身任务规划领域的模拟器与数据集彼此割裂，各自采用独立的观测格式、动作类型与任务域，阻碍统一评测与训练数据扩展。
summary.importance: 系统创新与数据贡献：提出首个整合4种主流具身模拟器的统一接口UniETP，同时构建标准化评测体系与跨域任务多样性增强机制。
summary.technical_approach: 将AI2-THOR、VirtualHome、Habitat、BEHAVIOR四个模拟器形式化为统一的观测空间与动作空间，设计支持复杂任务目标的评测系统，并从任务逻辑、场景复杂度等多维度增强任务多样性与难度。
summary.experiments: 在四个模拟器的统一接口下开展具身规划任务的跨域泛化评测，对比不同模型在跨模拟器、跨任务类型下的成功率与泛化能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Embodied task planning simulators and datasets are highly fragmented, each using proprietary observation formats, action types and task domains, which hinders unified evaluation and training data scaling.
summary_en.importance: System and data contribution: proposes UniETP, the first unified interface integrating four mainstream embodied simulators, along with a standardized evaluation system and cross-domain task diversity enhancement mechanism.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes AI2-THOR, VirtualHome, Habitat and BEHAVIOR into a unified observation and action space, builds an evaluation system supporting complex task goals, and enhances task diversity and difficulty across dimensions such as task logic and scene complexity.
summary_en.experiments: Conducts cross-domain generalization evaluation for embodied task planning across the four unified simulators, comparing success rates and generalization ability of different models across simulators and task types (specific metrics not fully provided in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 具身Agent的模拟器统一接口工作，对LLM预训练研究员仅参考其任务标准化思路，看摘要与接口定义即可。
recommendation.en: A unified simulator interface for embodied agents; only the task standardization design is relevant for LLM pretraining researchers, read abstract and interface definition only.

paper.title: What Makes a Representational Prior Work? Feature Families, Label-Free Invariances, and Critical Windows in Grokking
paper.abstract: Companion work showed the grokking delay is causally the time to form task-structured representations, injectable via a contrastive prior. Here we characterize what makes such a prior work, across four axes, in 188 new runs. Content: a coherent, learnable prior built from the wrong feature family (magnitude bands) blocks generalization like a random partition (1/15 vs 0/20 grok; $p=0.43$ between them), confirming the companion's prediction that priors act at the level of the circuit's features.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“grokking 会不会发生”，而是“什么样的表征先验能真正推动 grokking，以及它为什么起作用”。更具体地说，作者沿着前作提出的因果解释继续往下拆：grokking 的长延迟来自任务结构化表征形成得太慢；如果在隐藏表示上施加一个与任务等价结构一致的对比式先验，就能改变泛化出现的时间。这里要回答四个更细的问题：第一，先验需要匹配到什么程度，究竟是只要结构连贯就行，还是必须落在与任务可泛化电路一致的 feature family 上；第二，是否必须依赖标签监督，还是只靠任务不变性就够；第三，这种先验必须在训练的哪个阶段介入，是否存在 critical window；第四，这个解释在不同任务、架构和归一化设置下是否仍然成立。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于 modular arithmetic 这个玩具任务本身，而在于它把“表征先验如何影响泛化形成”这件事拆成了可检验的机制命题。文章给出的结论很清楚：有效先验不是泛泛的结构约束，而是要与模型最终用于泛化的特征族对齐；标签并非必要，稀疏但方向正确的不变性监督也能显著加速；而且这种作用有明显的早期窗口，错过窗口后再加先验基本无效。对大模型预训练，这些结论对应到几个很实际的问题：数据增强和对比目标是否真的在塑造有用特征，而不是只是在施加额外优化压力；无标签结构信号能否替代部分昂贵标注；训练早期的数据配比、辅助损失和 curriculum 是否比后期更关键。量级上，这不是直接可迁移到 LLM recipe 的工程结论，但它提供了一个较扎实的机制模板，用来理解为什么某些 auxiliary objective、representation regularizer 或 invariance signal 会有用，为什么另一些看起来“也很有结构”的约束却会伤害泛化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上延续前作的设置：在一层 transformer 上做 (a+b) mod 97，主任务损失之外，在最终位置表示上加入 supervised contrastive loss。关键不是又加了一个辅助 loss，而是作者系统构造了几类“只改先验、不改其表面强度”的对照，去分辨先验到底通过什么机制起作用。

第一组是 content control，也就是 band structure。作者把正样本定义为共享 magnitude-band pair 的样本，例如按 ⌊a/10⌋、⌊b/10⌋ 分桶，得到 100 个类，类大小与真实等价类接近。这个先验是连贯的、可学习的，也不是随机噪声；但它依赖的是阈值/幅值类特征，而任务真正可泛化的 Fourier 电路依赖周期性特征。这样就能区分两种解释：如果“只要先验有结构、可学习”就行，band prior 应该像 sibling prior 一样有帮助；如果关键在 feature family 对齐，band prior 就会像随机分区一样阻碍泛化。实验支持后者。

第二组是 supervision control，也就是 commutativity prior。这里完全不用答案标签，只把 (a,b) 和 (b,a) 当作正样本。它只利用加法交换律这个任务家族先验，因此是 label-free invariance prior。这个设计很巧，因为它不是直接告诉模型“哪些样本同类”，而是给出一个稀疏的不变性约束；在 modular addition 里，交换后的样本确实共享同一个和，所以它是对真实等价结构的稀疏采样。作者进一步指出，稀疏性可能反而是优点：它提供方向正确但优化压力更温和的结构信号，减轻前作里观察到的 weight norm inflation 副作用。

第三组是 critical-window 实验。作者只在特定 epoch 区间打开先验损失，比较早期开、晚期开、全程开等设置。结论是先验必须在早期介入，才能改变后续表示形成轨迹；如果模型已经沿着不利路径进入记忆化盆地，后加先验很难把它拉回来。这一点和很多预训练中的“早期数据/目标决定后续表征几何”很接近。

第四组是 generality sweep。作者把分析扩展到 multiplication、subtraction、parity，不同架构变体（2-layer、MLP、LayerNorm 变体），并做 norm clamp sweep，测量前作提出的 delay-law exponent 在有无先验时如何变化。这里的重点不是追求统一提升，而是检验“表征先验 + 权重范数副作用”这个解释是不是稳健。文章还加了一个 sequence-task pilot，作为边界测试，说明这套机制目前更像是对算法任务和小模型训练动力学的精细解释，而不是已经覆盖一般序列建模。
summary.experiments:
实验最有信息量的结果有几组。

1. feature family 决定先验是否有效。band prior 15 次里只有 1 次出现 grokking，和 random partition 的 0/20 在统计上不可区分（Fisher exact p=0.43），但与 true structure 的 22/30 显著不同（p=2.3×10^-5）。这说明“结构连贯、类别大小匹配、可学习”都不够，先验若落在错误的特征族上，效果接近噪声结构。对照地，前作里的 sibling structure 虽然组合关系不对，但仍共享同一特征族，因此 14/15 能泛化。这个对照是全文最关键的证据。

2. 标签不是必要条件。commutativity prior 在 15/15 个 run 中全部泛化，而 random partition 是 0/20，显著性很强（p=3.1×10^-10）。相对同 seed baseline，中位数加速 2.7×。更有意思的是，它的成功率还高于使用标签定义真实等价类的 true-structure prior（22/30，二者比较 p=0.038）。作者给出的解释是：commutativity prior 更稀疏，每个被覆盖 anchor 只有一个正样本，因而提供了正确方向的几何约束，但不会像密集监督那样过度推高权重范数。

3. norm side-effect 仍然存在，但减弱。文中报告 commutativity arms 的 median peak weight norm 为 103，低于 supervised true-structure prior 的 130，但仍高于 baseline 的约 57。这与前作一致：辅助对比损失一方面加快结构形成，另一方面也会推高权重范数，延缓优化；最终效果取决于两者博弈。仅看最终 held norm 不够，轨迹更重要。

4. 与 norm clamp 结合后效果最好。把 label-free commutativity prior 与前作提出的 norm clamp（||W||=45）结合，5/5 run 全部 grok，且中位数加速达到 17×；有些 seed 在 1000 epoch 以内就完成泛化。这个结果说明，先验提供方向，norm control 去掉副作用，两者是可组合的。

5. critical window。虽然给出的全文片段没有列出全部表格数字，但作者明确报告：只在训练早期施加先验仍能保留大部分收益，而只在后期施加几乎不起作用。这不是简单的“多训练一段辅助 loss 就行”，而是表示几何在早期被锁定，后期更像是在已有表征上做微调。

6. 泛化范围。作者在 multiplication、subtraction、parity，以及 2-layer、MLP、LayerNorm 变体上做了扩展，结论是“feature-family alignment + early window + norm interaction”这套解释有一定稳健性，但不是无条件普适。sequence-task pilot 被明确当作边界探测，说明作者对外推范围是克制的。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，建议先抓三处。

第一，看 Introduction 里作者如何把问题拆成四个轴：content、supervision、timing、generality。这里能快速理解文章不是在重复前作，而是在验证前作机制解释的必要条件和边界。

第二，重点看 band prior 和 commutativity prior 两组实验。前者回答“为什么有些看起来也很有结构的先验反而没用”；后者回答“为什么无标签不变性也能起作用”。如果只读图表，优先找成功率、t_gen 分布、以及 weight norm 轨迹。band vs sibling vs random 的对照，是理解 feature family 这个概念最直接的入口。

第三，看 critical-window 和 norm-clamp 相关部分。这里最值得深挖的是：先验到底是在改变优化速度，还是在改变可达表示子空间；以及 norm inflation 为什么会成为残余失败模式。若你关心预训练 recipe，这部分比 modular arithmetic 本身更有迁移价值。

如果准备精读，建议把 companion paper 一起看，否则文中很多设计会显得像经验技巧。精读时要特别留意作者如何做 same-seed paired comparison、如何处理 censored runs、以及为什么 insist on matched class sizes 和 weight-norm-matched controls。这些实验卫生决定了机制结论是否站得住。预计泛读 30 分钟可抓主线，连同前作一起精读大约需要 1.5 到 2 小时。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than whether grokking happens: what makes a representational prior actually useful, and through which mechanism does it alter the memorization-to-generalization delay? Building on the companion paper, the authors treat grokking as a delayed formation of task-structured representations, then test four specific conditions behind that claim: whether a prior must match the task’s feature family rather than merely impose coherent structure; whether labels are necessary or a label-free invariance signal is enough; whether the prior must act early in training; and whether the account survives changes in task, architecture, and normalization.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is conceptual rather than directly recipe-level. The paper turns a vague intuition—"good inductive bias helps generalization"—into a more precise statement: a prior helps only when it aligns with the feature family used by the eventual generalizing circuit; sparse invariance supervision can be enough; and the effect is concentrated in an early training window. That maps cleanly onto practical pretraining questions: when auxiliary objectives shape useful geometry versus merely add optimization pressure, when unlabeled structural signals can substitute for labels, and why early-stage data mixture or regularization often matters more than late intervention. The work is still on small algorithmic tasks, so the contribution is not a drop-in LLM training recipe. What it does provide is a mechanism template for thinking about representation shaping, curriculum timing, and the interaction between helpful auxiliary losses and harmful optimization side effects.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup follows the companion paper: a one-layer transformer trained on modular addition, with the main task loss plus a supervised contrastive loss applied to the final-position representation. The key contribution is not the auxiliary loss itself, but a carefully designed set of controls that isolate why a prior works.

The first control is the band-structure prior. Positive pairs are defined by sharing the same magnitude-band pair, using bucketed values of a and b. This prior is coherent, learnable, and class-balanced relative to the true task structure. But it is built from threshold/magnitude features, whereas the known generalizing circuit for modular arithmetic relies on periodic/Fourier features. This lets the authors separate two hypotheses: if coherence alone is enough, the band prior should help; if feature-family alignment is necessary, it should behave like a random partition. The experiments support the latter.

The second control is the commutativity prior. Positive pairs are only commuted inputs, (a,b) and (b,a). This uses no answer labels at all. It injects a task-family invariance that is knowable before training and, in modular addition, corresponds to a sparse sample of the true equivalence structure because commuted pairs share the same sum. The design is important because it shows that the useful signal need not be dense label supervision; a weak but correctly aligned invariance can be sufficient.

The third component is the critical-window intervention. The prior is activated only during selected epoch ranges. This tests whether the prior changes optimization globally or whether it must shape representation geometry before the model settles into a memorization-dominated trajectory. The reported result is strongly asymmetric: early intervention works, late intervention mostly does not.

The fourth component is a generality sweep across tasks, architectures, and normalization settings, including multiplication, subtraction, parity, 2-layer variants, MLPs, and LayerNorm variants. The paper also revisits the norm-clamp mechanism from the companion work and measures how the delay-law exponent changes with and without the prior. An exploratory sequence-task pilot is included as a boundary check rather than a claim of broad universality.
summary_en.experiments:
Several results carry most of the paper’s weight.

1. Feature-family alignment, not mere coherence, determines usefulness. The band prior yields grokking in only 1 of 15 runs, statistically indistinguishable from a random partition baseline at 0 of 20 runs (Fisher exact p=0.43), and clearly different from the true-structure prior at 22 of 30 runs (p=2.3e-5). This is the cleanest evidence in the paper: a prior can be structured, learnable, and class-size matched, yet still fail if it is expressed in the wrong feature family.

2. Labels are not required. The commutativity prior generalizes in 15 of 15 runs, versus 0 of 20 for the random partition (p=3.1e-10), with a median 2.7x speedup over same-seed baselines. More interestingly, it is more reliable than the label-supervised true-structure prior itself (22 of 30; comparison p=0.038). The authors argue that sparsity is likely the reason: one positive per covered anchor gives the right geometric direction with gentler optimization pressure.

3. The norm side effect remains but is reduced. Median peak weight norm is reported as 103 for the commutativity prior, compared with 130 for the supervised true-structure prior and about 57 for the baseline. This supports the companion paper’s picture: the auxiliary prior helps representation formation but can also inflate weight norms, which delays or destabilizes generalization. The trajectory matters more than a single final norm value.

4. Combining the label-free prior with norm control gives the strongest result. With the norm clamp at ||W||=45, the commutativity prior achieves 5 of 5 successful grokking runs and a median 17x speedup, with some seeds generalizing in under 1,000 epochs. This is a strong demonstration that the useful structural signal and the harmful optimization side effect are separable and composable.

5. Critical-window behavior is clear. Even though the excerpt does not include every table, the paper states that early-only application preserves most of the benefit, while late-only application is largely ineffective. That points to path dependence in representation formation rather than a simple cumulative regularization effect.

6. Generality is partial, not unlimited. The same qualitative account appears across several arithmetic tasks and architecture variants, but the sequence-task pilot is framed as exploratory. The paper is careful not to overclaim beyond the regime where the mechanism is directly testable.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction. It lays out the four axes—content, supervision, timing, and generality—and makes clear that the paper is testing the necessity and boundary conditions of the companion paper’s causal story.

Then focus on the two central experiments: band prior and commutativity prior. The band prior explains why a structured prior can still be useless if it is built from the wrong features. The commutativity prior explains why labels are not essential if the invariance is aligned with the task. If figures are available, prioritize success-rate tables, time-to-generalization distributions, and weight-norm trajectories.

Next, read the critical-window and norm-clamp sections together. That is where the paper becomes most relevant to pretraining practice: the prior is not just accelerating optimization in a generic sense, it is shaping early representation geometry, while norm control removes a specific side effect.

For a deeper read, it helps a lot to read the companion paper alongside this one. Many design choices—same-seed pairing, censored-run handling, matched class sizes, and weight-norm-matched controls—matter because the claims are mechanistic, not just empirical. A quick read of this paper alone takes around 30 minutes; reading it carefully with the companion paper is closer to 1.5 to 2 hours.

recommendation.zh: Cohere关于grokking的机制研究，无标签不变性先验比有监督先验更能加速泛化，做预训练表征学习/数据先验设计可参考§3实验设计。
recommendation.en: Cohere's grokking mechanism study finding label-free invariance priors accelerate generalization better than supervised ones; refer to §3 experimental design for pretraining representation / data prior research.

paper.title: How to Tame Grokking: Representation Geometry as a Control Signal
paper.abstract: Grokking is a phenomenon in which neural networks initially memorize training data and only later exhibit strong generalization after prolonged optimization. Despite extensive recent study, the factors influencing the emergence and timing of grokking remain incompletely understood. We investigate the relationship between representation geometry and delayed generalization. We find that dimensionality collapse consistently precedes the onset of grokking in all evaluated settings. Motivated by thes

summary.core_problem: Grokking延迟泛化现象的调控手段多集中在优化与权重层面，缺乏直接通过隐藏表示几何结构干预泛化时序的方法，且表示维度与泛化转换的因果关联尚不明确。
summary.importance: 隐藏表示的有效维度是可调控的泛化控制信号，而非仅为诊断统计量；谱正则化思路可迁移到大模型预训练中调控表示结构、加速泛化或缓解过拟合，也为理解训练动态中的记忆-泛化转换提供了几何视角。
summary.technical_approach: 提出几何维度正则化（GeomDR），属于表示级谱正则化方法。核心是对每个隐藏层的激活计算协方差矩阵的特征值，惩罚前d*个主成分之外方向的方差，迫使表示的有效维度向目标维度收敛。正则化在初始训练阶段后激活，用余弦斜坡逐步增加强度，避免优化突变；默认应用于所有隐藏层，排除输入嵌入和输出层。
summary.experiments: 在模加法、模除法、排列组合三类grokking经典任务上测试，GeomDR可最多加速grokking达52倍；强正则化强度下也可延迟甚至抑制泛化。系统消融覆盖不同架构、干预时机、目标维度、随机种子，验证了有效维度变化始终先于记忆到泛化的转换。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第2节方法部分的GeomDR损失定义和调度策略，以及第3节实验中grokking加速/抑制的定量结果和维度时序分析；附录A的几何解释可按需参考。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing grokking control methods focus on optimization or weight-norm regulation, with no direct approach to manipulate hidden representation geometry to alter generalization timing, and the causal link between representational dimensionality and the memorization-to-generalization transition remains unconfirmed.
summary_en.importance: Effective dimensionality of hidden representations serves as a controllable generalization signal rather than a mere diagnostic statistic. The spectral regularization framework can be adapted to large model pretraining to shape representation structure, accelerate generalization, or mitigate overfitting, and provides a geometric lens to analyze training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Geometric Dimensionality Regularization (GeomDR) is a representation-level spectral regularizer. For each hidden layer, it computes eigenvalues of the activation covariance matrix and penalizes variance in directions beyond the top d* principal components to push representations toward a target effective dimensionality. The regularizer activates after an initial memorization phase with a cosine ramp schedule to avoid abrupt optimization shifts, and is applied to all hidden layers excluding input embeddings and output heads.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three standard grokking tasks: modular addition, modular division, and permutation composition. GeomDR accelerates grokking by up to 52x under moderate strength, and can delay or suppress generalization under stronger regularization. Systematic ablations across architectures, intervention timings, target dimensionalities, and random seeds confirm that effective dimensionality changes consistently precede the memorization-to-generalization transition.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 2 (GeomDR loss formulation and scheduling) and Section 3 (quantitative results on grokking acceleration/suppression and dimensionality timing analysis). Appendix A (geometric interpretations) is optional. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看表示维度塌缩先于泛化的证据和 GeomDR ablation；玩具任务外推到 LLM 要保守。
recommendation.en: Read the evidence for dimensionality collapse preceding generalization and the GeomDR ablations; extrapolate to LLM training only as a weak mechanistic prior.

paper.title: An exact information theory of generalization phase transitions in Bayesian diffusion models
paper.abstract: How diffusion models circumvent the curse of dimensionality to learn complex distributions over high dimensional spaces from a finite training set, instead of memorizing it, remains a fundamental mystery. To address this, we introduce analytically tractable Bayesian information restricted diffusion (BIRD) models, in which each pixel observes restricted information about noisy data. A BIRD model time-reverses diffusion by inferring which past training sample produced its current restricted observ

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型为何能在高维空间中从有限训练集泛化而非记忆，缺乏可解析的理论解释。
summary.importance: 基础理论贡献，提出可解析的BIRD模型族，首次给出扩散模型记忆-泛化相变的信息论边界。
summary.technical_approach: 引入贝叶斯信息受限扩散（BIRD）模型，每个像素仅观测带噪数据的受限信息，通过贝叶斯后验推断训练样本做时间反转；推广了空间局部信息受限的解析扩散模型。
summary.experiments: 证明空间局部BIRD在训练早期近似UNet、DiT等真实训练的扩散模型；在最小数据分布假设下，推导出训练数据量-噪声强度联合空间中的记忆-泛化相变边界。
summary.authors_note: Surya Ganguli为斯坦福大学知名计算神经科学与深度学习理论研究者，长期从事泛化与涌现机制研究。

summary_en.core_problem: There lacks an analytically tractable theoretical explanation for why diffusion models generalize rather than memorize when learning high-dimensional distributions from finite training sets.
summary_en.importance: Fundamental theoretical contribution; proposes the analytically tractable BIRD model family and derives the first information-theoretic phase boundary between memorization and generalization for diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Bayesian information-restricted diffusion (BIRD) models, where each pixel observes only restricted information about noisy data and time-reverses diffusion via Bayesian posterior inference over training samples; generalizes existing analytic diffusion models with spatially local information restriction.
summary_en.experiments: Shows spatially local BIRD closely approximates real trained diffusion models (UNets, DiTs) early in training; under minimal data distribution assumptions, derives an information-theoretic memorization-generalization phase boundary in the joint space of training data amount and noise strength.
summary_en.authors_note: Surya Ganguli is a well-known researcher at Stanford University in computational neuroscience and deep learning theory, with long-standing work on generalization and emergent mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 纯扩散模型泛化理论，对做Diffusion LM的人可参考相变边界推导，主流AR预训练研究员无需深入。
recommendation.en: Pure generalization theory for diffusion models; reference the phase boundary derivation if working on Diffusion LM, not essential for mainstream AR pretraining researchers.

paper.title: Broken Ergodicity and the Violation of the Fluctuation-Dissipation Theorem Lead to Generalization Beyond Overfitting in Machine Learning
