We provide an analytical model of this process: structure extraction is formalized as principal compo

summary.core_problem: 两阶段学习（无监督预训练+下游线性探测/微调）场景下，表示维度（隐藏层大小）如何与预训练数据量、下游标注数据量、任务结构共同作用影响泛化性能，目前缺少高维场景下的定量解析框架。
summary.importance: 为隐藏层维度选择、预训练数据与标注数据的性价比权衡提供了理论参考，可指导算力在增维、加无监督数据、加标注数据三者之间的最优分配，适配当前预训练阶段大规模缩放维度与数据的实践需求。
summary.technical_approach: 将无监督预训练形式化为尖峰协方差模型下的PCA特征提取，下游任务简化为线性回归。在高维渐近假设下推导训练误差、估计误差、泛化误差的精确解析表达式，进一步识别不同参数区域下的最优表示维度，以及无监督数据价值超过标注数据的相变点。最后通过自编码器训练、预训练Transformer线性探测实验验证理论结论。
summary.experiments: 理想PCA+线性回归设置下，误差表达式的准确性得到验证。识别出两个相变区域：任务信号集中在少数主成分时，低维压缩表示泛化更优；任务信号分散在大量成分时，高维表示更优。当无监督数据量远大于标注数据量时，增加无监督数据的收益高于增加同量级标注数据。自编码器与预训练Transformer的线性探测实验中，表示维度与泛化误差的关联趋势与理论预测一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的问题定义与贡献总结、第3章的核心定理结论，以及图2（无监督/标注数据价值对比）、图3（维度选择的相变区域）、图4（真实模型验证结果），跳过复杂的数学证明部分，预计阅读时间30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: There lacks a quantitative analytical framework in the high-dimensional regime to characterize how representation dimensionality interacts with pretraining data volume, downstream labeled data volume, and task structure to shape generalization performance in the standard two-stage learning paradigm of unsupervised pretraining followed by downstream linear probing or fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: It provides theoretical references for hidden layer dimension selection and cost-performance tradeoff between pretraining data and labeled data. It can guide optimal compute allocation across scaling model dimension, adding unsupervised data, and adding labeled data, which aligns with current pretraining practice that heavily scales both dimension and data size.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formalizes unsupervised pretraining as PCA feature extraction under a spiked covariance model, and downstream learning as linear regression. Under high-dimensional asymptotic assumptions, it derives exact analytical expressions for training error, estimation error, and generalization error. It further identifies the optimal representation size across different parameter regimes, and the phase transition point where unsupervised data becomes more valuable than labeled data. Theoretical conclusions are validated via autoencoder training and linear probing experiments on pretrained transformers.
summary_en.experiments: The accuracy of derived error expressions is first verified in the ideal PCA + linear regression setting. Two phase transition regimes are identified: low-dimensional compressed representations achieve better generalization when task signal concentrates on a few principal components, while high-dimensional representations perform better when task signal is dispersed across a large number of components. When unsupervised data volume is much larger than labeled data, adding unsupervised data yields higher gains than adding the same amount of labeled data. Linear probing experiments on autoencoders and pretrained transformers produce generalization error vs. dimension curves consistent with theoretical predictions.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 1 for problem definition and contribution summary, core theorem conclusions in Section 3, Figure 2 (value comparison between unsupervised and labeled data), Figure 3 (phase transition regimes for dimension selection), and Figure 4 (validation on real models). Skip complex mathematical proofs. Estimated reading time: 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“表示维度”当一等公民做可解析推导，适合校准你对线性探针与表征瓶颈的直觉；重点看最优维度随label/unlabel比变化的相图。
recommendation.en: A clean analytic treatment that makes representation size a first-class knob; skim for the phase diagram of optimal dimension vs labeled/unlabeled data and task alignment.

institutions: Institute of Science and Technology Austria

paper.title: First-Passage Prediction of Grokking Delay: ACalibrated Law under AdamW with Causal Validation
paper.abstract: We give the first quantitative prediction of grokking delay under AdamW. Treating the delay as a first-passage time, we derive a closed-form law T_grok - T_mem = (1 / 2 kappa_LL eta lambda) log(V_mem / V_star), where V_t = ||theta_t||^2 is the squared parameter norm, V_star is an architecture-dependent threshold, and kappa_LL absorbs the AdamW correction to the clean-SGD contraction rate 2 eta lambda. Calibrating (kappa_LL, V_star) on a single hyperparameter cell predicts grokking delays on 26 h

summary.core_problem: 现有grokking研究能够刻画记忆后的训练动力学特征，但无法对AdamW优化器下grokking延迟的具体时长给出定量预测，也缺乏因果机制层面的验证。核心问题是：在标准AdamW训练中，泛化跃迁在验证集上何时发生，以及驱动该跃迁的因果机制是什么。
summary.importance: 首个给出AdamW下grokking延迟封闭形式预测公式的工作，MAPE达到17.7%。将grokking建模为联合(参数范数,角度位移)空间中的首次穿越问题，提供了可操作的训练监控指标。因果干预验证为理解长训练动态中的泛化机制提供了坚实证据，对预训练中的训练动态监控和超参数调校有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将grokking延迟T_grok - T_mem建模为首次穿越时间（first-passage time）。核心观察：(1)参数范数V_t=||θ_t||²以速率2κ_LL η λ指数收缩至架构依赖的阈值V_star；(2)角度位移α_t必须达到角度阈值α_star；二者同时满足时grokking发生。封闭公式为T_grok - T_mem ≈ (2κ_LL η λ)^{-1} log(V_mem / V_star)，其中κ_LL是吸收了AdamW修正的架构级常数。通过Theorem 1证明了联合范数-角度必要性（正延迟需要V_mem > V_post且α可达α_star），通过Block F因果干预（冻结范数、冻结权重衰减）验证机制必要性。
summary.experiments: 93条训练轨迹验证V_t的指数收缩（R²≈0.97）。在26个留出超参数运行上预测延迟MAPE 17.7%（覆盖41×延迟范围），跨架构（1L→MLP）MAPE 18.0%，跨任务全范围（46次运行，43.5×范围）MAPE 23.3%。κ_LL在同一架构内稳定（CV≤15%），架构间约2倍差异。因果干预：冻结范数或权重衰减均消除grokking（0/6 vs 基线3/3），α被困在12°远低于经验阈值47°。跨cell校准：在p=89上校准后预测p=97的α_star为47.2°，实际47.8°，误差1.3%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Section 2（核心公式与框架）、Section 5（主要实验结果）和Section 6.5（因果干预实验），Theorem 1证明在Appendix H，不需深入。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing grokking research characterizes post-memorization training dynamics but lacks quantitative prediction of grokking delay magnitude under AdamW, as well as causal mechanism validation. The core question is: when does the generalization transition occur on the validation set under standard AdamW training, and what is the causal mechanism driving it?
summary_en.importance: This work provides the first closed-form prediction of AdamW grokking delay with MAPE 17.7%. It models grokking as a first-passage problem in the joint (parameter norm, angular displacement) space, yielding actionable metrics for training monitoring. Causal intervention validation provides solid evidence for understanding generalization in long training dynamics, with relevance for pretraining monitoring and hyperparameter tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models grokking delay T_grok - T_mem as a first-passage time. Key observations: (1) Parameter norm V_t=||θ_t||² contracts exponentially at rate 2κ_LL η λ toward an architecture-dependent threshold V_star; (2) Angular displacement α_t must reach an angular threshold α_star. Grokking occurs only when both conditions are met. The closed-form law is T_grok - T_mem ≈ (2κ_LL η λ)^{-1} log(V_mem / V_star), where κ_LL is an architecture-level constant absorbing AdamW corrections. Theorem 1 proves joint norm-direction necessity for positive delay. Causal Block F interventions (norm freeze, weight decay freeze) validate the mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: Exponential contraction of V_t confirmed across 93 training trajectories (R²≈0.97). Delay prediction on 26 held-out hyperparameter runs achieves MAPE 17.7% over a 41× delay range. Cross-architecture (1L→MLP) MAPE 18.0%; cross-task full scope (46 runs, 43.5× range) MAPE 23.3%. κ_LL is stable within architecture (CV≤15%), varying ~2× across architectural variants. Causal interventions: both norm-freeze and wd-freeze eliminate grokking (0/6 vs 3/3 baseline), trapping α near 12° ≪ empirical α_star≈47°. Cross-cell calibration: calibrated on p=89 predicts α_star=47.2° for p=97 (observed 47.8°, error 1.3%).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (core formula and framework), Section 5 (main experimental results), and Section 6.5 (causal intervention experiments). Theorem 1 proof is in Appendix H and does not require deep reading for a high-level understanding. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Grokking延迟定量预测的扎实工作，闭式公式和分位数边界定理对理解训练动态很有价值，重点看§3的公式推导。
recommendation.en: Solid work on quantitative prediction of grokking delay; the closed-form formula and quantile-margin theorem are valuable for understanding training dynamics, focus on §3 formula derivation.

institutions: H&K Research Studio, Clevix LLC, Hanoi

paper.title: GRLO: Towards Generalizable Reinforcement Learning in Open-Ended Environments from Zero
paper.abstract: Post-training has become a crucial step for unlocking the capabilities of large language models, with reinforcement learning (RL) emerging as a critical paradigm. Recent RL-based post-training has increasingly split into two paradigms: reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), which optimizes models using human preference signals in target domains, and reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), which operates in verifier-backed environments. The latter has dominated recent r

summary.core_problem: 现有面向LLM的域内RL后训练需要大量GPU算力，且从零开始在开放环境中基于少量交互学习的RL策略的泛化能力尚未被系统研究。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，探索开放环境下从零训练的RLHF的对话能力泛化潜力。
summary.technical_approach: 摘要未披露完整技术方案，核心设定为在开放环境中使用少量交互数据从零训练RLHF，评估其对话能力的跨场景泛化表现。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型、训练数据、基线及量化效果指标，仅明确研究方向。
summary.authors_note: 团队来自加州大学河滨分校，无公开知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing in-domain RL post-training for LLMs requires massive GPU compute, and the generalization ability of RL policies trained from scratch with limited interactions in open-ended environments has not been systematically studied.
summary_en.importance: Analytical contribution, explores the generalization potential of conversational abilities from RLHF trained from scratch in open-ended environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Full technical details are not disclosed in the truncated abstract; the core setup is training RLHF from scratch with limited interaction data in open-ended environments, and evaluating cross-scene generalization of conversational abilities.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model, training data, baseline or quantitative performance metrics are disclosed in the truncated abstract, only the research direction is stated.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from University of California, Riverside; no publicly well-known researchers.

recommendation.zh: RL后训练泛化性的初步探索，摘要信息不全，仅作领域动态了解即可。
recommendation.en: Preliminary exploration of RL post-training generalization, incomplete abstract information, only for general field awareness.

paper.title: Detecting overfitting in Neural Networks during long-horizon grokking using Random Matrix Theory
paper.abstract: Training Neural Networks (NNs) without overfitting is difficult; detecting that overfitting is difficult as well. We present a novel Random Matrix Theory method that detects the onset of overfitting in deep learning models without access to train or test data. For each model layer, we randomize each weight matrix element-wise, $\mathbf{W} \to \mathbf{W}_{\mathrm{rand}}$, fit the randomized empirical spectral distribution with a Marchenko-Pastur distribution, and identify large outliers that viol

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：在没有训练集、验证集、优化器状态和完整 checkpoint 历史的情况下，能否只从权重中识别模型是否进入了有害过拟合。论文把 long-horizon grokking 作为可观测实验场景，区分 pre-grokking、grokking 和 anti-grokking。关键点是 pre-grokking 和 anti-grokking 都可能表现为训练准确率高、测试准确率低，但前者是尚未学到泛化结构，后者是学到后又丢失了泛化结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把过拟合诊断从 loss/accuracy 曲线转向 weight-only diagnostics。对于开源基座模型、持续预训练 checkpoint、长程训练后的模型筛查，这类方法有实际吸引力，因为很多时候无法访问训练数据和 held-out loss。贡献更像一个诊断假设和实证工具，而不是已经可直接用于大规模预训练质量认证的方法。原因是实验主体仍以 grokking 和受控任务为主，GPT-OSS 20B/120B 的筛查更像示例性分析，尚不能证明 trap profile 与真实下游鲁棒性之间存在稳定因果关系。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于随机矩阵理论。对每个线性层权重矩阵 W，先做 element-wise shuffle 得到 W_rand，再构造协方差矩阵 X_rand = 1/N · W_rand^T W_rand。若权重元素在随机化后接近独立同分布，谱分布应接近 Marchenko-Pastur bulk，右边界附近只有 Tracy-Widom 量级的有限样本波动。论文把明显越过 MP/TW 右边界的谱离群点定义为 Correlation Traps。直觉是：这些离群方向表示非 self-averaging 的结构，一小部分方向主导统计量，可能对应训练后期形成的脆弱相关性。与直接看原始权重谱不同，shuffle 后再拟合 MP 是为了构造一个更接近 i.i.d. 的 null model，避免把普通结构化学习信号都当成异常。论文还用 eigenvector localization、condensation 等现象解释 trap 的非随机性，并尝试通过基于 JSD 的行为测试区分 harmful traps 和 benign traps。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个受控设置：MNIST MLP、modular addition Transformer，以及 GPT2-style Transformer 的 long-horizon grokking。共同现象是：在模型进入泛化阶段时，trap count 保持较低；当训练继续推进、测试准确率下降而训练准确率仍保持高位时，Correlation Traps 开始形成，并在数量和尺度上增长。这个信号能区分 pre-grokking 与 anti-grokking，虽然二者从 train/test accuracy 的粗粒度形态上可能相似。论文还对 GPT-OSS 20B/120B checkpoint 做 layer-wise trap profile 筛查，展示该方法可扩展到 foundation-scale 权重分析。提供内容中没有足够细节确认具体阈值、各层 trap 数量、JSD 数字或与下游评测的相关系数，因此不宜把它解读为已完成的大模型质量评估标准。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看方法定义部分，尤其是为什么要 shuffle 权重、如何拟合 MP bulk、如何用 MP/TW 右边界定义 trap。然后看三组 grokking 实验的曲线，关注 trap count 与 test accuracy 下降的时间关系。GPT-OSS 20B/120B 的 layer profile 可以快速扫一遍，主要看方法在大权重矩阵上的工程可行性。需要谨慎阅读的是因果解释部分：spectral outlier 与有害过拟合之间还需要更多真实预训练 checkpoint、不同数据配比、不同优化器和不同架构的验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether harmful overfitting can be detected from model weights alone, without access to training data, validation losses, optimizer state, or checkpoint history. It uses long-horizon grokking as the controlled setting, where pre-grokking, grokking, and post-generalization anti-grokking can be observed in one training run.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the weight-only diagnostic angle. If reliable, this kind of method could help triage open-weight checkpoints, continual-pretraining runs, and long training jobs where held-out curves are missing or incomplete. The current contribution should be read as a promising diagnostic hypothesis rather than a mature foundation-model certification method. The strongest evidence comes from controlled grokking setups; the large-model screening is informative but does not yet establish a robust link to downstream robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each layer matrix W, the method shuffles entries element-wise to form W_rand and computes X_rand = 1/N · W_rand^T W_rand. Under an approximately i.i.d. null, the empirical spectral distribution should follow a Marchenko-Pastur bulk, with finite-size fluctuations near the right edge described by Tracy-Widom behavior. Outliers far beyond this edge are called Correlation Traps. The interpretation is that these outliers mark non-self-averaging structure: a small number of directions dominate the layer statistics and may encode brittle correlations. The shuffle step is important because it defines a simpler random-matrix null; the paper is not merely counting large singular values in the original trained weights.
summary_en.experiments: The reported controlled experiments include an MNIST MLP, a Transformer on modular addition, and a GPT2-style Transformer in a long-horizon grokking regime. In all three cases, trap counts remain low while generalization improves, then grow when the model enters anti-grokking: training accuracy stays high, but test accuracy deteriorates. This separates anti-grokking from pre-grokking, even though both can look similar under coarse train/test accuracy summaries. The paper also applies the layer-wise trap analysis to GPT-OSS 20B and 120B checkpoints. The supplied content does not provide enough detail to quote exact trap counts, thresholds, JSD values, or downstream correlations.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is sufficient. Read the definition of Correlation Traps carefully: the shuffle procedure, MP fitting, and right-edge outlier criterion are the core mechanics. Then inspect the grokking figures and compare the timing of trap formation with the drop in test accuracy. The large-checkpoint profiles are worth scanning for scalability and layerwise behavior. Treat the causal interpretation with caution; the next evidence needed would be systematic validation on real pretraining runs with known data, optimizer, and evaluation histories.

recommendation.zh: 做预训练健康监控和grokking研究的可以参考，Correlation Traps的谱检测思路可落地到训练pipeline中
recommendation.en: Referenceable for researchers working on pretraining health monitoring and grokking; the spectral Correlation Traps detection method can be implemented in training pipelines.

paper.title: When Symbol Names Should Not Matter: A Logistic Theory of Fresh-Symbol Classification
paper.abstract: Template tasks have emerged as a clean testbed for asking whether transformers reason with abstract symbols rather than concrete token names. We study the fixed-label classification version of this problem, where train and test examples share latent templates but may use disjoint vocabularies. Unlike next-token prediction, the model need not emit unseen symbols; it must learn a decision rule invariant to symbol renaming. We analyze regularized kernel logistic classification in the transformer-ke

summary.core_problem: 在模板分类任务中，Transformer 是否能学习到独立于具体 token 名称的抽象符号规则（即 fresh-symbol 泛化），以及有限训练样本中的 token 碰撞如何影响这种泛化能力。
summary.importance: 从理论上解释了 Transformer 在处理抽象符号时为何容易受到表面模式干扰。将语义上的可分性与统计上的 token 碰撞解耦，为理解模型何时能真正掌握抽象规则（而非死记硬背）提供了严格的核方法（kernel）视角。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Transformer-kernel 机制下分析正则化核逻辑回归。将学习到的预测器分解为理想的模板级分类器和由训练数据中偶然的 token 重叠引起的有限样本扰动。引入“彩色碰撞图（colored collision graph）”来编码这些重叠，并证明了高概率的 margin-transfer 保证。证明了只要碰撞图足够良性（即扰动小于理想分类器的 margin），经验分类器就能正确标记由全新符号组成的测试样本。
summary.experiments: 理论推导为主。通过构建具有相同 token 频率和边缘碰撞计数，但度结构、颜色对不平衡度和谱范数不同的碰撞图，证明了词汇多样性（vocabulary diversity）只是一个边缘代理指标，无法完全刻画碰撞分布对泛化的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对 fresh-symbol 泛化和 token 碰撞的定义，以及 Informal theorem 的表述。理解彩色碰撞图如何量化有限样本扰动是核心。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether Transformers can learn abstract symbolic rules independent of concrete token names (fresh-symbol generalization) in template classification tasks, and how token collisions in finite training samples affect this capability.
summary_en.importance: Provides a theoretical explanation for why Transformers are susceptible to surface patterns when processing abstract symbols. It decouples semantic separability from statistical token collisions, offering a rigorous kernel perspective on when models truly grasp abstract rules rather than memorizing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes regularized kernel logistic classification in the Transformer-kernel regime. Decomposes the learned predictor into an ideal template-level classifier and a finite-sample perturbation caused by accidental token overlaps in the training data. Introduces a 'colored collision graph' to encode these overlaps and proves high-probability margin-transfer guarantees. Shows that if the collision graph is benign enough (perturbation is smaller than the ideal classifier's margin), the empirical classifier correctly labels test samples composed of entirely new symbols.
summary_en.experiments: Primarily theoretical derivations. Demonstrates that vocabulary diversity is only a marginal proxy by constructing collision graphs with identical token frequencies and edge collision counts but different degree structures, color-pair imbalances, and spectral norms, showing they lead to different generalization behaviors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definitions of fresh-symbol generalization and token collisions in the Introduction, and the statement of the Informal theorem. Understanding how the colored collision graph quantifies finite-sample perturbation is key. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关于 Transformer 符号推理泛化能力的硬核理论分析，通过碰撞图解释了词表大小和序列长度对泛化的影响，适合做机制分析的研究员阅读。
recommendation.en: Hardcore theoretical analysis on Transformer symbolic reasoning generalization, explaining the impact of vocabulary size and sequence length via collision graphs; suitable for mechanism analysis researchers.

paper.title: Rethinking Data Curation in LLM Training: Online Reweighting Offers Better Generalization than Offline Methods
paper.abstract: Data curation is a critical yet under-explored area in large language model (LLM) training. Existing methods, such as data selection and mixing, operate in an offline paradigm, detaching themselves from training. This separation introduces engineering overhead and makes the curation brittle: the entire pipeline must be re-run under model/task shifts. Moreover, offline methods alter data size through hard filtering or resampling, often sacrificing data diversity and harming generalization. We pro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、但长期被工程化经验掩盖的问题：训练数据该如何按任务目标动态分配权重。现有主流做法，无论是数据过滤、子集选择，还是数据混合比例搜索，大多都属于 offline curation：先用代理模型或启发式给样本打分，再固定成一个子集或静态采样分布，最后重新训练主模型。问题在于，这种做法把“样本价值”当成静态量，而真实训练里样本价值会随模型状态变化；同时硬过滤会直接改变支持集，牺牲长尾和分布覆盖，容易换来 benchmark 内收益、benchmark 外退化。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何把数据筛选/混合/平衡统一成一个训练中的在线重加权问题，在不丢数据多样性的前提下，让样本贡献随训练动态调整，并且直接对齐验证分布。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把 data selection、data mixing、data balancing 放进同一个 reweighting 视角里，这个统一表述很有价值，因为很多看似不同的数据工程技巧，其实只是权重空间里的不同约束：二值权重对应过滤，分组权重对应 mixture，连续样本权重对应更细粒度控制。第二，它给出一个更贴近真实大规模训练流程的替代方案：不再反复跑“打分—筛选—重训”的多阶段 pipeline，而是在训练时直接调节每个样本的 loss 权重，工程上更轻，也更适合模型、数据、任务不断变化的环境。第三，论文最重要的结论不是单点提分，而是 generalization 取舍的变化：保留全量数据、只调节更新幅度，往往比删掉一部分数据更稳，尤其在跨 benchmark、跨 domain 评测上更明显。对做 pretrain 的人，这意味着数据质量控制未必应该优先做 hard filtering，很多时候更该研究 sample-wise learning rate / loss weight 的在线控制。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者提出 ADAPT，把数据整理写成一个 validation-guided online reweighting 框架。核心思想很直接：训练集样本的权重，不是由静态代理分数一次性决定，而是由当前模型状态下该样本与验证集的“对齐程度”动态决定。论文先形式化一个统一评分函数 s(x; θ, D_val)，其中 x 是训练样本，θ 是当前或代理模型，D_val 是目标验证集。offline 方法相当于在训练前用固定 θ0 计算一次 s，再把它变成固定权重 w(x)；ADAPT 则在训练过程中周期性更新这个信号，并把它转成连续 loss weight，相当于给每个样本分配一个自适应步长。

从全文描述看，ADAPT 的关键不是简单按 loss 大小重权，而是用训练样本与验证集之间的相似性来估计“对目标分布是否有帮助”。这点和很多基于难例挖掘、loss-based curriculum 的在线方法不同。后者容易把高 loss 样本都当成重要样本，但高 loss 也可能只是噪声、异常值或明显 out-of-domain 数据。ADAPT 试图回答的是另一个问题：这个样本的梯度更新方向，是否更接近验证集需要的方向。实现上，论文强调它是 global reweighting，而不是只在 mini-batch 内做局部归一化；同时它避免显式改写数据分布，不做重采样、不删样本，只改 loss contribution，因此额外开销接近于零。

从统一框架角度看，作者把很多已有方法都解释成 ADAPT 的特例或近似：如果权重是 0/1，就是 selection；如果按 domain 分组给固定比例，就是 mixing；如果按 group-level validation gap 调整，就是 balancing。ADAPT 的区别在于三个点：一是 sample-level，而不是 domain-level；二是 online，而不是 pre-computed；三是 soft weighting，而不是 hard subset。也正因为这三点，它更容易保留数据覆盖面，同时跟随训练阶段变化。论文还把方法同时用于 pretraining 和 fine-tuning，说明它不是只适合某个特定 regime，而是一个更一般的数据权重控制接口。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的价值在于评测协议比较统一，而且同时覆盖 pretraining 与 instruction tuning。论文报告的主结果是：在统一 FLOP 预算下，ADAPT 相比 LESS、DoReMi、RegMix 等 offline 基线，以及已有 online reweighting 方法，最高可达到 7.2% 的 accuracy-per-FLOP 提升；在跨 benchmark 的 out-of-domain 泛化上，最高有 6.1% 的优势。这个指标选择是合理的，因为 online weighting 的一个卖点就是不需要额外重训和复杂预处理，如果只看最终精度而不看算力，容易低估它的实际价值。

从全文给出的实验结构看，作者重点验证了几件事。第一，online soft weighting 比 offline hard filtering 更稳。即便 offline 方法能在某些 in-domain 验证集上得到不错结果，一旦测试分布变化，性能更容易掉，因为它已经永久删掉了一部分训练支持。第二，保留全量数据对 generalization 有帮助，尤其是长尾和弱相关样本并非完全无用，它们在不同训练阶段可能有不同价值。第三，动态更新权重优于静态权重，说明样本重要性确实不是常数。第四，ADAPT 在 instruction tuning 上也有效，说明这种 validation-guided weighting 不只是预训练语料清洗工具，也可以看成 post-train 阶段的数据配比器。

论文还做了消融来拆解收益来源，重点通常包括：是否需要 sample-level 而非 group-level 权重；权重更新频率对效果和稳定性的影响；不同相似度/质量信号的选择；是否必须保留全量数据；以及额外计算开销。作者的结论是，收益主要来自动态、细粒度、连续的重权，而不是某个特定打分器本身。若只做静态打分再软权重，效果会弱于真正在线更新。若退化成 domain-level mixing，也会损失一部分细粒度收益。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看引言和 unified formalization 部分。这里不是铺垫，而是全文最有信息量的地方：作者把 selection、mixing、balancing 都改写成 reweighting，这个视角决定了后面方法和实验该怎么理解。然后重点看方法章节里权重如何由 validation alignment 得到，尤其要弄清楚三个问题：权重到底作用在 loss 还是 sampling 上；更新频率多高；为什么额外开销可以接近零。接着看主实验表，先抓 accuracy-per-FLOP 和 out-of-domain generalization 两个主指标，再看与 LESS、DoReMi、RegMix 的对比，不要只盯单一 benchmark。

如果时间够，最值得精读的是消融和分析图。重点看：保留全量数据 vs 过滤子集的差异；静态权重 vs 动态权重；sample-level vs domain-level；以及训练过程中权重分布如何演化。这几部分决定这篇工作的真正启发点：它不是又一个“更好的打分器”，而是在重新定义数据整理应该发生在训练前还是训练中。对做大规模预训练的人，值得深挖的是它和 DoReMi 这类 domain reweighting 的关系，以及它是否可以进一步和 curriculum、cooldown、continual pretrain 结合。预计认真读完方法和实验需要 1.5 到 2 小时。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a central but often over-engineered question in LLM training: how to assign importance to training data in a way that matches the model’s evolving needs. Most existing curation pipelines are offline. They score examples once with a proxy model or heuristic, then either filter data or fix a sampling mixture before the actual training run. That design assumes sample value is static. In practice, it is not. A sample that is useful early may become redundant later, and hard filtering permanently removes coverage that may matter for robustness. The paper asks whether data curation should be reframed as an online weighting problem, where the full dataset is retained and each sample’s contribution is adjusted during training based on its alignment with the target validation distribution.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution matters less as a one-off algorithm and more as a change in how to think about data curation. First, it gives a clean unification: data selection, data mixing, and balancing can all be written as special cases of reweighting. Binary weights recover filtering, group-level weights recover mixture tuning, and continuous sample weights give a more expressive version of both. Second, it argues for moving curation from a preprocessing pipeline into the training loop. That is important for large-scale pretraining, where rerunning proxy scoring and retraining after every model or corpus change is expensive and brittle. Third, the empirical message is about generalization, not just in-domain gains: keeping the full corpus and modulating update magnitude often generalizes better than subtractive curation. For pretraining research, this suggests that hard filtering may be overused, and that sample-wise loss weighting or adaptive effective learning rates deserve more attention.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed method, ADAPT, is a validation-guided online reweighting framework for both pretraining and fine-tuning. The paper starts from a general scoring function s(x; θ, D_val), where x is a training example, θ is a model state or proxy model, and D_val is a validation set representing the target distribution. In offline curation, this score is computed once before training and converted into fixed weights or a selected subset. ADAPT instead updates the signal during training and uses it to assign continuous per-sample loss weights.

The key design choice is that weighting is driven by alignment with the validation set rather than by raw training loss alone. That is an important distinction. Loss-based online curricula often overemphasize hard examples, but high loss can come from noise, corruption, or out-of-domain content. ADAPT tries to estimate whether a sample is useful for the target distribution, not merely whether it is difficult. Operationally, the method acts like an adaptive per-sample step size: all data remain in the corpus, but their gradient contribution is scaled according to their current relevance.

Another useful aspect is the paper’s unified view of prior work. Offline selection becomes a 0/1 weighting scheme. Domain mixing becomes grouped weighting with fixed or slowly varying coefficients. Balancing methods are also reinterpreted as constrained reweighting. ADAPT differs along three axes: it is online rather than precomputed, sample-level rather than only domain-level, and soft rather than hard. Those choices explain why it can preserve diversity while still steering optimization toward the validation distribution. The paper also emphasizes that the method is global rather than merely batch-local, and that it adds almost no extra overhead because it does not require explicit resampling or rebuilding the dataset.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental section is strong mainly because it evaluates the method under a unified protocol and across both pretraining and instruction tuning. The headline result is up to 7.2% higher accuracy per FLOP than offline baselines such as LESS, DoReMi, and RegMix, as well as prior online reweighting methods. It also reports up to 6.1% better out-of-domain generalization across benchmarks. Accuracy-per-FLOP is the right lens here, since an online method should be judged not only by final accuracy but also by whether it avoids the repeated proxy-score-and-retrain cycle of offline curation.

The experiments support several concrete claims. First, online soft weighting is more robust than offline hard filtering. Offline methods can look good on the validation target they optimize for, but they are more brittle once the evaluation distribution shifts, because they have already discarded part of the training support. Second, retaining the full dataset helps generalization. Weakly relevant or long-tail examples are not uniformly useless; their value changes over training. Third, dynamic weights outperform static weights, which directly supports the paper’s premise that sample importance is not fixed. Fourth, the gains transfer from pretraining to instruction tuning, suggesting that the method is not just a corpus-cleaning trick but a more general data allocation mechanism.

The ablations appear to focus on the right questions: sample-level versus group-level weighting, dynamic versus static weights, the choice of similarity or quality signal, update frequency, and the effect of keeping the full corpus versus filtering. The main takeaway is that the benefit comes from dynamic, fine-grained, continuous reweighting rather than from a particular scorer alone.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the unified formalization section. That is where the paper does its most useful conceptual work. The reweighting lens is not cosmetic; it determines how to interpret both the method and the baselines. Then read the method section carefully, with three questions in mind: where exactly the weights enter the objective, how often they are updated, and why the overhead stays near zero. After that, go straight to the main result tables and focus on the two central metrics: accuracy per FLOP and out-of-domain generalization. The comparisons against LESS, DoReMi, and RegMix are more informative than any single benchmark win.

If reading time is limited, the most valuable deep-read targets are the ablations and analysis figures. Pay attention to full-data retention versus subset filtering, static versus dynamic weighting, and sample-level versus domain-level control. Those sections reveal the real contribution: this is less about inventing a better scoring heuristic and more about relocating data curation from preprocessing into optimization. For pretraining researchers, the most interesting follow-up question is how this framework relates to domain reweighting methods like DoReMi and whether it can be combined with curriculum schedules, cooldown phases, or continual pretraining. A careful read of method plus experiments should take around 1.5 to 2 hours.

recommendation.zh: 将数据curation从离线预处理转为在线动态重加权是一个有吸引力的范式转变，对预训练数据策略有直接参考价值，方法和实验都值得仔细阅读。
recommendation.en: Reframing data curation from offline preprocessing to online dynamic reweighting is a compelling paradigm shift with direct implications for pretraining data strategy — method and experiments both merit careful reading.

paper.title: Are Flat Minima an Illusion?
paper.abstract: Neural networks that land in flat regions of the loss landscape tend to generalise better than those in sharp regions. Sharpness-Aware Minimisation exploits this to improve generalisation. But function-preserving reparameterisation can inflate the Hessian of any minimum by two orders of magnitude without changing a single prediction. If the geometry of weight space can be manufactured from nothing, it cannot be the cause of anything. In other words, flat is simple and simplicity depends on encod

summary.core_problem: 这项工作质疑“flat minima 导致更好泛化”这一常见解释。核心问题是：如果通过不改变函数的重参数化就能大幅改变 Hessian sharpness，那么权重空间的平坦性是否还能作为泛化因果因素。作者提出用 weakness 描述已学习函数留下多少可兼容的 completion，并把它作为更接近函数层面的复杂度指标。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于提醒训练动态分析不要过度依赖参数坐标中的几何量。大模型训练中常用 sharpness、Hessian trace、loss landscape 等指标解释 batch size、optimizer、泛化和稳定性，但这些指标可能受参数化、归一化和尺度选择影响。weakness 的思路把关注点从“权重附近的损失形状”转向“函数行为在模型可表达语言中的约束强度”。不过实验规模很小，主要是 MNIST/Fashion-MNIST 上的三层 ReLU MLP，距离 LLM 预训练还有很大距离，更适合作为概念性提醒，而不是可直接采用的训练准则。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于 Stack Theory 的形式化语言。环境 Φ 表示可能状态，program 是状态集合，vocabulary 是 learner 可表达的约束集合。一个 statement 是一组相容约束，其 truth set 非空。completion 指在保持当前 statement 的同时还能追加的相容约束，weakness 就是 completion 的数量。直观上，weakness 越高，函数承诺越少，留下的兼容扩展越多。作者把这一概念扩展到连续域，并证明它按构造对重参数化不敏感，因为定义对象是函数行为和可表达约束，而不是某个参数坐标下的曲率。为把它落到 ReLU 网络上，文中构造了两类 vocabulary：region-class vocabulary 把激活区域近似地独立处理；feature-classifier vocabulary 保留共享权重约束，并把单点 extension 检查化为线性规划。后者更接近网络真实结构，但 pair proxy 仍是边际量相加，不是完整 extension 计数。
summary.experiments: 实验包含三组关键信息。第一，在 MNIST 三层 ReLU MLP 上，large-batch 相对 small-batch 的泛化优势随训练集变大而减弱：500、2,000、6,000、12,000 样本时 large-batch 更好；24,000 样本时差距约 +0.08 个百分点，p=0.002；60,000 样本时约 +0.02 个百分点，几乎可忽略。作者用它说明某些 sharpness 相关现象可能是数据规模相关的混杂。第二，函数保持不变的重参数化可让 Hessian trace 变化最高约 99 倍，而泛化完全不变。第三，在 100 个相同架构、相同数据和相同训练设置的网络上，weakness 与泛化的相关性优于 sharpness：weakness 的 Spearman ρ=+0.374，p=0.00012；sharpness 的 ρ=-0.226，p=0.024；simplicity 不显著，p=0.848。Fashion-MNIST 上复现到相近强度，ρ 约 +0.38，p 约 1e-4。buffer size k_free 也有弱相关，ρ=+0.117，p=0.043。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30–45 分钟。建议先看 Introduction 中三个贡献的设定和数字，再看 reparameterisation invariance 的证明思路，最后看实验和 Appendix H/I 的 operationalization。最值得细看的是 feature-classifier vocabulary 如何把 shared-weight constraint 转成线性可行性问题，因为这是从抽象理论走向神经网络度量的关键环节。对 LLM 训练研究者，不必深挖 Stack Theory 的全部定义，重点应放在它对 sharpness 解释的限制、函数层指标的设计原则，以及这些指标是否可能扩展到 Transformer 表示空间。

summary_en.core_problem: The work challenges the causal reading of flat minima. If a function-preserving reparameterization can substantially change Hessian-based sharpness without changing predictions, then flatness in weight space is not a stable explanation of generalization. The proposed alternative is weakness: the volume of behaviorally compatible completions left by the learned function in the learner’s expressive language.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is conceptual. Analyses of large-scale training often use sharpness, Hessian traces, and loss landscape geometry to explain batch-size effects, optimizer behavior, stability, and generalization. This work argues that such quantities can be artifacts of parameter coordinates. Weakness shifts the object of study from local curvature around weights to the strength of functional commitments made by the trained model. The evidence is still small-scale, using three-layer ReLU MLPs on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST, so it is not a directly usable criterion for LLM pretraining. It is more useful as a warning about coordinate-dependent diagnostics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework comes from Stack Theory. An environment is a set of possible states; a program is a subset of states; a vocabulary is the set of constraints expressible by the learner. A statement is a consistent conjunction of programs. A completion is any stronger consistent statement that extends the current one, and weakness is the number of such completions. Intuitively, a weak learned function leaves many compatible extensions and is less over-committed. The author extends this notion to continuous domains and proves reparameterization invariance by defining the quantity over behavior and expressible constraints rather than over a particular parameter coordinate system. To apply it to ReLU networks, the work introduces two vocabularies. The region-class vocabulary treats activation regions approximately independently. The feature-classifier vocabulary respects shared weights and reduces single-point extension checks to linear feasibility problems. The latter is more faithful to the architecture, although the pair proxy is still a sum of marginals rather than a full extension count.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section has three notable results. First, on MNIST with a three-layer ReLU MLP, the apparent generalization advantage of large-batch over small-batch training shrinks with dataset size: it appears at 500, 2,000, 6,000, and 12,000 training points, drops to about +0.08 percentage points at 24,000 points with p=0.002, and becomes about +0.02 percentage points at 60,000 points. Second, function-preserving reparameterizations change the Hessian trace by up to about 99x while leaving generalization unchanged. Third, across 100 networks with the same architecture, data, and training setup, weakness predicts model selection better than sharpness: weakness has Spearman rho +0.374 with p=0.00012, while sharpness has rho -0.226 with p=0.024; the simplicity measure is not predictive with p=0.848. Fashion-MNIST gives a similar signal, with rho around +0.38 and p around 1e-4. The buffer-size variable k_free is statistically significant but modest, with rho +0.117 and p=0.043.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate. Read the introduction for the three claims and the numerical setup, then inspect the reparameterization-invariance argument, the experimental section, and Appendices H and I. The most useful technical part is the feature-classifier vocabulary, because it shows how the abstract completion-count idea is converted into linear feasibility checks under shared weights. For LLM pretraining, the key question is not the small MLP result itself, but whether function-level, coordinate-invariant diagnostics can be built for Transformer representations and large-scale optimization.

recommendation.zh: 直接挑战平坦极小值对应更好泛化的核心共识，新提出的weakness度量对预训练优化有参考，重点读§3证明与Fig2。
recommendation.en: Directly challenges the core consensus that flat minima correspond to better generalization; the proposed weakness metric is valuable for pretraining optimization, focus on §3 proofs and Fig 2.

paper.title: On the Blessing of Pre-training in Weak-to-Strong Generalization
paper.abstract: The paradigm of Weak-to-Strong Generalization (W2SG) suggests that a pre-trained strong model can surpass its weak supervisor, yet the decisive role of pre-training remains theoretically and empirically under-explored. In this work, we identify pre-training as the essential prerequisite for the emergence of W2SG. Theoretically, we formalize the W2SG problem within a high-dimensional single-index model framework using spiked Gaussian data, modeling pre-training as a spectral initialization step.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 weak-to-strong generalization 为什么依赖预训练：强模型为什么能在弱监督标签上超过弱监督者，而随机初始化模型通常做不到。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把预训练从“提供更好特征”具体化为“把模型放入可学习的几何区域”。这个角度能解释为什么同样的弱标签，在不同预训练阶段的 checkpoint 上会产生不同结果。它也提示，post-train 的可监督性和预训练中形成的表示几何有关，而不只是模型参数量或微调算法的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 理论部分使用 high-dimensional single-index model 和 spiked Gaussian data。spike vector 表示预训练数据中可检测的潜在语义方向。预训练被建模为 spectral initialization，也就是让模型初始点和真实方向有非随机对齐。作者在已有随机初始化不可学习结果的基础上，证明当预训练把模型带入一个 effective region 后，局部 loss landscape 呈现 perturbed strong-convexity geometry。这个区域内，即使弱监督标签有噪声，梯度仍有指向 ground truth 的恢复力。可行条件包括：预训练数据中存在可检测 latent signal，下游任务和该 signal 有足够 intrinsic alignment，弱监督者不是纯噪声，学习率保持稳定。理论还给出一个动态图景：早期性能由 signal pull 推动上升，随后受弱监督噪声形成瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 实验分两部分。合成实验用于验证理论假设，包括 spiked structure、warm start、弱监督噪声和学习率稳定性对 W2SG 成败的影响。真实模型实验评估 Pythia 和 OLMo 家族中数百个中间预训练 checkpoint，观察 W2SG 随预训练推进出现相变：早期 checkpoint 即使有弱标签也难以超过弱监督者，预训练足够深入后进入可成功的区域。作者还报告 W2SG 表现与 linear representations 的出现存在稳健正相关，即模型越能把高层概念编码为 activation space 中的线性方向，越容易在弱监督下产生超过监督者的表现。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。重点看理论设定中 spiked Gaussian、single-index model 和 spectral initialization 的定义，以及 effective region 的几何条件。实验部分优先看 Pythia/OLMo checkpoint 随训练进度变化的曲线，因为这部分最贴近预训练研究。线性表示相关性可以作为机制线索阅读，但不宜过度解释为因果证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why weak-to-strong generalization depends on pretraining: why a pretrained strong model can outperform its weak supervisor after training on weak labels, while a randomly initialized model often cannot.
summary_en.importance: The useful point for pretraining research is the geometric interpretation. Pretraining is treated as a warm start that places the model in a learnable region, not merely as a source of better generic features. This helps explain why the same weak labels can work on later checkpoints but fail on earlier ones. It also connects post-training success to representation geometry acquired during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The theory uses a high-dimensional single-index model with spiked Gaussian inputs. The spike represents a latent concept direction that can be recovered from pretraining data. Pretraining is modeled as spectral initialization, giving the model non-random alignment with the ground-truth direction. Building on impossibility results for random initialization, the paper proves that weak-to-strong generalization becomes feasible when this initialization lands inside an effective region. Inside that region, the loss has a perturbed strongly convex geometry, so gradients retain a restoring force toward the true concept despite noisy weak supervision. The required conditions are a detectable pretraining signal, sufficient alignment between the pretraining signal and the downstream task, an informative weak supervisor, and a stable learning rate. The resulting bound describes an initial improvement phase driven by the latent signal, followed by saturation caused by weak-label noise.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section first uses controlled synthetic simulations to check the assumptions and dynamics predicted by the theory. It then evaluates hundreds of intermediate checkpoints from the Pythia and OLMo model families. The main observation is a phase transition along the pretraining trajectory: early checkpoints remain in a failure regime for weak-to-strong learning, while sufficiently pretrained checkpoints enter a successful basin. The paper also reports a positive correlation between weak-to-strong performance and the emergence of linear representations, measured by how well high-level concepts are encoded as linear directions in activation space.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should take about 30 to 45 minutes. Focus on the definitions of the spiked Gaussian model, the single-index setup, and spectral initialization. The most relevant empirical figures are the Pythia and OLMo checkpoint curves over pretraining time, because they connect the theory to actual pretraining trajectories. The linear-representation analysis is useful as a mechanistic clue, but it should be read as correlational rather than causal evidence.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不直接给新 recipe，但它把“预训练只是更好初始化”改写成“没有几何暖启动就学不出来”；先看理论设定和饱和瓶颈那部分，能帮助你重新理解 weak-supervision post-train 的边界。
recommendation.en: Not a new recipe, but it upgrades the prior from 'pretraining helps' to 'without geometric warm start, W2SG may not happen at all'; read the setup and saturation argument first.

paper.title: Model Spec Midtraining: Improving How Alignment Training Generalizes
paper.abstract: Some frontier AI developers aim to align language models to a Model Spec or Constitution that describes the intended model behavior. However, standard alignment fine-tuning -- training on demonstrations of spec-aligned behavior -- can produce shallow alignment that generalizes poorly, in part because demonstration data can underspecify the desired generalization. We introduce model spec midtraining (MSM): after pre-training but before alignment fine-tuning, we train models on synthetic documents

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 alignment fine-tuning 的泛化方向不可控问题。标准做法只用示范数据教模型“该怎么答”，但示范数据往往不能说明“为什么这样答”。当同一组行为可以由多种价值解释时，模型会选择哪一种解释并外推到新场景，训练者并不容易控制。论文提出的问题很具体：能否在 AFT 之前，用一段中间训练让模型先理解 Model Spec 的内容，从而改变后续对相同示范数据的泛化方式。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-training 接口有直接启发。MSM 不是常规 SFT，也不是偏好优化；它把 Model Spec 写成一批可学习的合成文档，在预训练之后、对齐微调之前注入模型。它的贡献不在于多加一批安全样本，而在于证明“规范文本的语义预热”可以改变后续示范学习的归纳偏置。这个结果对 mid-training、annealing/cooldown、continual pretrain 都有参考意义：如果 demonstration signal 欠约束，先训练模型理解规则背后的理由，可能比直接堆示范更有效。论文也把 Model Spec 从静态政策文档变成可实验的训练对象，可以比较不同 spec 写法对泛化的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含两个阶段。第一阶段是 Model Spec Midtraining。给定一个 Model Spec，用 Claude Opus 4.6 生成多样化合成文档，这些文档不只是列规则，而是讨论 spec 中的价值、边界、理由和行为含义。模型在这些文档上做中间训练，目标是让模型先掌握“应该成为什么样的助手”以及“为什么要这样做”。第二阶段是 Alignment Fine-Tuning，在 spec-aligned demonstrations 上训练模型执行相应行为。关键区别在于，AFT 仍然负责把原则落到行为模式上，但 MSM 负责设定解释框架和外推方向。论文的控制实验设计得比较干净：同一批 cheese preference AFT 数据可以同时被解释为 pro-America，也可以解释为 pro-affordability。只改变 MSM 中的 spec，不改变 AFT 数据，模型最后会朝不同价值方向泛化。这说明 MSM 改变的不是表层样本记忆，而是示范数据的解释方式。相对 Constitutional AI 或 deliberative alignment，MSM 更靠前，发生在对齐微调之前；相对单纯扩大 AFT 数据，它试图补充的是“示范数据没有写出来的原则”。
summary.experiments: 论文给出两类主要实验。第一类是受控价值泛化实验。模型只在 cheese preference 数据上做 AFT，例如偏好 cream cheese 而不是 brie。若 MSM spec 把这些偏好解释为亲美价值，模型会在相同 AFT 后泛化到更广泛的 pro-America 表达；若 MSM spec 把同一批偏好解释为 affordability，模型则泛化到 pro-affordability。论文报告该现象还覆盖另外 6 种 value setting，说明它不是单个玩具偏好的偶然结果。第二类是安全相关的 agentic misalignment 评测。对 self-preservation 和 goal-guarding 写入 Model Spec 后，MSM 明显降低不对齐行为比例：Qwen2.5-32B 从 68% 降到 5%，Qwen3-32B 从 54% 降到 7%。deliberative alignment baseline 分别为 48% 和 14%，MSM 在这两个模型上都更低。论文还比较了不同 AFT 数据规模：MSM 的收益在多个规模下存在，但 AFT 数据越多，边际收益越小。这符合直觉，因为更大规模示范本身也会提供更多外推线索。消融上，论文用 MSM 做 Model Spec science：解释规则背后价值的 spec、以及带有更细 subrules 的 spec，泛化效果更好；只写“要有好的价值和判断”这类很泛的规范，效果较差。这个结果说明 spec 的可操作性和解释密度比抽象口号更重要。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 §2、§3、§4、§5。§2 重点看 MSM 数据如何从 Model Spec 生成，以及它和 AFT 数据的职责分工；这里决定了方法是否可复现，也决定了是否会发生数据泄漏或目标混淆。§3 是核心机制实验，尤其是 Figure 1 的 cheese preference 设计：相同 AFT、不同 spec、不同泛化，是判断 MSM 是否真的改变归纳偏置的关键证据。§4 看 agentic misalignment 的设置、指标和 baseline，重点关注 Qwen2.5-32B 与 Qwen3-32B 的绝对降幅，以及不同 AFT scale 下收益变小的曲线。§5 值得细看，它把 spec 写法变成可优化对象：价值解释、细规则、泛化规范之间的差异，对真实 Model Spec 迭代很有用。深挖时应特别关注三点：合成文档是否覆盖了评测语义；MSM 是否会降低模型在 spec 外场景的灵活性；当 spec 内部冲突或过度具体时，模型会如何折中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a precise failure mode in alignment fine-tuning: demonstrations often specify the desired behavior but not the intended reason behind it. When the same demonstrations are compatible with several value-level explanations, the model may generalize along the wrong one. The question is whether a model can be trained, before alignment fine-tuning, to understand a Model Spec well enough that later demonstrations are interpreted through the intended principles.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at the pretrain–posttrain boundary. Model Spec Midtraining is not just another SFT dataset and not a preference-optimization method. It inserts a midtraining phase after pretraining and before alignment fine-tuning, using synthetic documents that explain the Model Spec. This changes the model’s inductive bias before it sees behavioral demonstrations. For pretraining researchers, the result is useful because it shows that document-style semantic training can shape downstream alignment generalization, especially when demonstration data is underdetermined. It also turns a Model Spec from a policy artifact into a trainable and experimentally testable object.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. First, Model Spec Midtraining trains the model on a diverse synthetic corpus generated from a Model Spec, using Claude Opus 4.6 for data creation. These documents discuss the assistant’s intended values, rules, motivations, and practical boundaries. The goal is to teach the model the content and rationale of the spec before behavioral fine-tuning. Second, Alignment Fine-Tuning trains the model on demonstrations of spec-aligned behavior. The important design choice is the separation of roles: MSM supplies the explanatory frame, while AFT supplies behavioral grounding. The controlled cheese-preference setup makes this clear. The same AFT data can be explained either by pro-America values or by pro-affordability values. Changing only the MSM spec changes how the model generalizes from the identical AFT data. Compared with standard SFT, MSM does not merely add more examples of desired behavior. Compared with deliberative alignment, it acts earlier, before the model is trained to produce aligned responses.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover both controlled generalization and safety-relevant behavior. In the controlled value experiments, models are fine-tuned only on cheese preferences such as preferring cream cheese over brie. With a pro-America spec during MSM, the model generalizes the same preference data toward broader pro-America values. With a pro-affordability spec, it generalizes toward affordability instead. The paper reports the same pattern across six additional values. In agentic misalignment evaluations, adding an MSM spec about self-preservation and goal-guarding sharply reduces misalignment rates: Qwen2.5-32B drops from 68% to 5%, and Qwen3-32B drops from 54% to 7%. A deliberative alignment baseline reaches 48% and 14%, respectively, so MSM is stronger in these settings. The gains persist across AFT data scales, but become smaller as AFT scale increases, which is consistent with larger demonstration sets being less underdetermined. The spec-ablation results are also informative: specs that explain the values behind rules, or include more detailed subrules, generalize better than a broad instruction to have good values and judgment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 2 for the data-generation pipeline and for the division of labor between MSM and AFT. This is where reproducibility and possible confounds should be checked. Section 3 is the key mechanism test: the cheese-preference setup, especially Figure 1, isolates whether MSM changes the interpretation of identical AFT data. Section 4 is the main safety result; focus on the exact agentic misalignment benchmark, the Qwen2.5-32B and Qwen3-32B numbers, and the dependence on AFT data scale. Section 5 is worth careful reading because it studies how different spec designs affect generalization. The most useful follow-up questions are whether the synthetic MSM documents overlap semantically with the evaluations, whether MSM makes behavior too rigid outside the covered spec, and how the method behaves when the spec is internally ambiguous or overly detailed.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该按“训练阶段设计”来读，不是普通对齐技巧；如果结果经得起复现，它会直接改变你对 SFT 前该不该插一段目标化 LM mid-train 的 prior，先看受控泛化实验和 misalignment 表。
recommendation.en: Read this as a training-stage paper, not just another alignment trick; if the results hold, it changes the prior on whether a targeted LM midtraining phase should sit before SFT—start with the controlled generalization setup and the misalignment table.

paper.title: Critical Windows of Complexity Control: When Transformers Decide to Reason or Memorize
paper.abstract: Recent work has shown that Transformers' compositional generalization is governed by \emph{complexity control}, initialization scale and weight decay, which steers training toward low-complexity reasoning solutions rather than high-complexity memorization. Existing analyses, however, treat complexity control as a single static hyperparameter choice, leaving open \emph{when} during training this control is actually decisive. We show that the memorization-versus-reasoning fate of a Transformer is

summary.core_problem: Transformer 在组合泛化任务中选择“推理”（泛化）还是“记忆”（过拟合），其决定性因素（复杂度控制，如权重衰减）是否只在训练的特定时间窗口内起作用？
summary.importance: 打破了“复杂度控制是静态超参数”的传统认知，揭示了 Transformer 训练动态中存在一个决定泛化命运的“关键窗口”。这对于理解模型如何学习组合规律、以及如何更高效地分配正则化预算具有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: 在受控的组合任务（anchor-function）上，对小型 Transformer 进行大量种子级别的实验。通过在训练的不同阶段施加权重衰减，并保持总正则化预算不变，观察模型最终的 OOD（分布外）准确率。结合理论分析（线性化双层注意力模型），解释了记忆和推理回路在不同时间尺度上的演化。
summary.experiments: 发现权重衰减仅在训练的 25% 窗口（如 [2500, 17500) 步之间）内施加，即可达到与全程施加相当的 OOD 准确率（0.93 vs 0.91）。在总预算相同的情况下，中间阶段施加正则化效果好，早期施加则导致模型崩溃（OOD 准确率降至随机水平）。初始化尺度（γ）会影响关键窗口的位置，较小的 γ 会使窗口提前，但也会缩小推理盆地（basin of attraction）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 5.2（关键窗口的发现）和 5.3（预算控制下的时机重要性）。Section 5.4 展示了窗口边界的陡峭性，非常有趣。理论部分（Sec. A）可以作为补充，理解时间尺度分离的机制。注意作者给出的“诚实的负面结果”（Sec. C.4-C.6），明确了该现象的适用边界。

summary_en.core_problem: Is the decisive factor (complexity control, e.g., weight decay) for whether a Transformer chooses 'reasoning' (generalization) or 'memorization' (overfitting) on compositional generalization tasks only effective within a specific time window during training?
summary_en.importance: Challenges the traditional view of 'complexity control as a static hyperparameter', revealing the existence of a 'critical window' in Transformer training dynamics that determines its generalization fate. This provides important insights for understanding how models learn compositional rules and how to allocate regularization budgets more efficiently.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conducted extensive seed-level experiments on small Transformers using a controlled compositional task (anchor-function). By applying weight decay at different stages of training while keeping the total regularization budget constant, the final OOD (out-of-distribution) accuracy was observed. Combined with theoretical analysis (linearized two-layer attention model), it explains the evolution of memorization and reasoning circuits on different timescales.
summary_en.experiments: Found that applying weight decay only within a 25% window of training (e.g., between steps [2500, 17500)) achieves OOD accuracy comparable to full-training application (0.93 vs 0.91). With the same total budget, applying regularization in the middle stages works well, while early application leads to model collapse (OOD accuracy drops to chance level). The initialization scale (γ) affects the position of the critical window; a smaller γ shifts the window earlier but also shrinks the basin of attraction for reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 5.2 (discovery of the critical window) and 5.3 (importance of timing under budget control). Section 5.4 shows the sharpness of the window boundary, which is very interesting. The theoretical part (Sec. A) can be used as a supplement to understand the mechanism of timescale separation. Note the 'honest negative results' provided by the authors (Sec. C.4-C.6), which clarify the applicable boundaries of this phenomenon.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 weight decay 作用的 critical window，对理解 grokking 和优化 pretrain 调度有启发，建议看实验 setup 和 window 边界的分析。
recommendation.en: Reveals the critical window for weight decay, inspiring for understanding grokking and optimizing pretrain schedules; recommend checking the experimental setup and window boundary analysis.

paper.title: Beyond the Training Distribution: Mapping Generalization Boundaries in Neural Program Synthesis
paper.abstract: Large-scale transformers achieve impressive results on program synthesis benchmarks, yet their true generalization capabilities remain obscured by data contamination and opaque training corpora. To rigorously assess whether models are truly generalizing or merely retrieving memorized templates, we introduce a strictly controlled program synthesis environment based on a domain-specific arithmetic grammar. By systematically enumerating and evaluating millions of unique programs, we construct inter

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“程序合成能不能做”，而是一个更基础也更难回答的问题：在训练语料完全可控、测试样本与训练集距离可度量的条件下，Transformer 在程序合成里到底是在泛化，还是只是在训练分布附近做局部插值。作者为此构造了一个严格受控的算术 DSL 环境，枚举数百万个程序，并把每个程序同时放到语法空间和语义空间里，从而能精确区分两类泛化：同一支持集内的数据密度迁移，以及超出训练支持集的外推。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值不在于它提出了新的大模型架构，而在于它把“泛化边界”这个平时很难测的东西做成了可操作实验对象。代码模型、算法学习、合成数据预训练都长期受数据污染和训练集不可见的困扰，这篇工作提供了一种更干净的分析范式：先把任务空间显式参数化，再讨论模型对分布密度、结构覆盖和支持集边界的响应。对基座研究员来说，最有用的结论有两个。第一，训练数据的覆盖方式比单纯从一个自然分布里多采样更关键，尤其是在结构化任务上。第二，扩大算力和模型规模能持续改善性能，但对超出语法支持集的外推帮助有限，提升更像对数线性而不是出现能力跃迁。这对“只靠 scale 是否足以学会算法泛化”给出了偏保守的证据。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计很克制，重点在可测性而不是任务复杂度。作者先定义一个一元标量算术程序的上下文无关文法，终结符包括 x、四则运算以及 sin/cos/exp/log/sqrt，抽象语法树的运算节点深度限制为 L=6，用穷举方式生成所有合法程序。随后做程序约简，去掉语义等价或无效表达式，得到可管理但仍然足够大的程序集合。

核心创新是双流形表示。语法流形用结构相似度刻画程序树之间的距离，语义流形则通过程序在输入网格上的函数行为来定义距离。这样一来，作者不只是知道一个样本“没见过”，而是知道它在结构上离训练集多远、在行为上离训练集多远。基于这两个空间，作者构造了两类分布偏移：
1. density generalization：测试样本仍落在训练支持集覆盖的区域内，但训练采样密度不同，考察模型能否从稠密区域推广到稀疏区域；
2. support generalization：测试样本位于训练支持集之外，尤其是语法结构上超出训练覆盖，考察真正外推。

训练数据选择是论文里最有信息量的部分。作者比较了多种采样策略，不只看自然频率采样，还显式做语法多样性采样、语义多样性采样，以及同时覆盖语法和语义的联合多样性采样。结论是，只优化单一维度的覆盖并不够，联合覆盖能显著改善 OOD 泛化。这一点和预训练里的数据配比、去重、覆盖率设计很像：不是样本越多越好，而是支持集的几何形状决定了模型能学到什么。
summary.experiments:
关键结果主要有四类。

第一，OOD 距离和性能之间存在清晰关系。随着测试样本在语法空间里离训练集越来越远，Transformer 的 pass@k 明显下降。论文强调语法距离比单纯语义距离更能决定失败模式，说明模型对程序结构分布的依赖很强。

第二，训练集采样策略显著影响泛化。作者报告，若从单一分布采样，pass@1 大约在 10% 左右；若训练集同时在语法和语义空间上做多样化覆盖，pass@1 可提升到约 19%。这个提升幅度在受控环境里不小，因为测试分布是刻意隔离过的，不太可能来自模板记忆。

第三，support generalization 依然很难。即便增加训练算力或模型规模，超出语法支持集后的性能提升仍然有限，趋势接近 log-linear，而不是在某个规模点突然跨过去。作者把这解释为 Transformer 更擅长局部插值和边界附近泛化，而不是系统性外推。

第四，论文还做了不同 split 构造和距离定义下的稳健性检查，说明结论不是某一种切分方式偶然造成的。虽然给出的全文片段里没有完整参数表，但从引言可确认实验是在数百万枚举程序上进行，且比较重点是不同数据分布设计对 pass@1 / pass@k 的影响，而不是追求大模型绝对分数。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Methodology，抓住两个关键词：semantic manifold 和 syntactic manifold。只要理解作者如何把程序空间变成“可测距离的几何空间”，后面的实验就容易读。

建议重点看三部分。第一，DSL 构造、枚举和 reduction 过程。这里决定了实验是否真的干净，尤其要看作者如何处理等价表达式、非法值和搜索空间爆炸。第二，train/test split 的定义方式。要确认 density shift 和 support shift 是否被严格区分，避免把“稀有样本”误当成“外推样本”。第三，采样策略对比图和 OOD 距离曲线，这部分最接近对预训练数据设计的启发。

如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，建议看引言、任务定义图、主要结果图和结论。若要精读，值得深挖两个点：一是语法距离与语义距离哪个更预测失败；二是联合多样性采样为什么优于单维多样性，这和代码预训练里的 curriculum、mixture design、coverage-aware sampling 可以直接类比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more fundamental question than raw program-synthesis accuracy: under a fully controlled training distribution, when does a transformer genuinely generalize, and when is it only interpolating near memorized templates? To answer that, the authors build a transparent arithmetic DSL, enumerate millions of programs, and place each program in both a syntactic and a semantic metric space. This makes distribution shift measurable rather than anecdotal, and allows them to separate in-support density shift from true out-of-support extrapolation.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is methodological. In code modeling and algorithmic reasoning, contamination and opaque corpora make it hard to tell whether gains come from real abstraction or retrieval from nearby examples. This work provides a clean experimental template: explicitly parameterize the task space, define distances to the training set, and study how performance degrades as coverage changes. Two conclusions matter for foundation-model researchers. First, coverage of the training support matters more than naive sampling from a single distribution, especially for structured tasks. Second, scaling helps, but only smoothly and only up to a point; it does not remove the extrapolation barrier once test programs move outside the syntactic support seen in training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is intentionally simple so that the analysis is identifiable. The authors define a context-free grammar over unary scalar arithmetic programs with operators such as +, -, *, /, sin, cos, exp, log, and sqrt, and cap AST depth at L=6. They then brute-force enumerate valid programs and reduce the set by removing invalid or redundant forms.

The central idea is a dual-manifold representation. A syntactic manifold captures structural distance between program trees, while a semantic manifold captures behavioral distance based on function outputs over sampled inputs. This lets the authors quantify not only whether a test sample is unseen, but how far it is from the training set structurally and behaviorally.

Using these spaces, they define two generalization regimes. Density generalization keeps test samples within the same support but changes how densely regions are covered during training. Support generalization moves test samples outside the training support, especially in syntax, to test genuine extrapolation. They then compare multiple data-selection strategies: sampling from a single distribution, maximizing syntactic diversity, maximizing semantic diversity, and jointly covering both spaces. The strongest result is that joint semantic-plus-syntactic coverage yields better OOD behavior than optimizing either axis alone. That is a useful analogue to pretraining data mixture design: the geometry of support matters, not just sample count.
summary_en.experiments:
There are four main empirical findings.

First, performance degrades predictably with OOD distance, especially in syntactic space. As test programs move farther from the training set structurally, pass@k drops substantially. The paper suggests that syntactic distance is a stronger predictor of failure than semantic distance alone.

Second, training-set construction has a large effect on generalization. The authors report that models trained from a single distribution achieve roughly 10% pass@1, while a deliberately diversified training set spanning both semantic and syntactic spaces reaches about 19% pass@1. In this controlled setting, that is a meaningful gain because contamination is largely ruled out.

Third, support generalization remains difficult even with more compute. Scaling improves results consistently, but the gains remain roughly log-linear rather than showing a sharp transition into robust extrapolation. The model gets better at interpolation and near-boundary generalization, but not at systematic out-of-support reasoning.

Fourth, the paper includes robustness checks across split constructions and distance definitions, which helps show that the conclusions are not artifacts of one particular partitioning scheme. The full text fragment here does not expose every model-size table, but the study clearly operates over millions of enumerated programs and focuses on pass@1/pass@k under controlled distribution design rather than headline absolute accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and methodology. The key is to understand how the semantic and syntactic manifolds are defined, because the rest of the paper is built around those distances.

Three parts deserve attention. First, the DSL construction, enumeration, and reduction pipeline. This determines whether the benchmark is truly clean, especially how equivalent expressions and invalid programs are handled. Second, the exact definition of train/test splits. Check carefully that density shift and support shift are separated rather than conflated. Third, the sampling-strategy comparisons and the curves against OOD distance; these are the parts most relevant to pretraining data design.

For a quick read, 20 to 30 minutes is enough for the introduction, task-definition figures, main result plots, and conclusion. For a deeper read, focus on two questions: whether syntactic distance or semantic distance better predicts failure, and why joint diversity sampling beats one-dimensional diversity. Those points connect directly to curriculum design, coverage-aware sampling, and data-mixture construction in code pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座方法论文，但评测 setup 很干净；若你在做代码预训练或合成数据，重点看它怎样把 interpolation 和 extrapolation 拆开，别只盯最终分数。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model methods paper, but the setup is unusually clean; if you work on code pretraining or synthetic curricula, read it for how it separates interpolation from true extrapolation.

paper.title: Language Diffusion Models are Associative Memories Capable of Retrieving Unseen Data
paper.abstract: When do language diffusion models memorize their training data, and how to quantitatively assess their true generative regime? We address these questions by showing that Uniform-based Discrete Diffusion Models (UDDMs) fundamentally behave as Associative Memories (AMs) $\textit{with emergent creative capabilities}$. The core idea of an AM is to reliably recover stored data points as $\textit{memories}$ by establishing distinct basins of attraction around them. Historically, models like Hopfield n

summary.core_problem: 论文研究离散语言扩散模型什么时候是在记忆训练样本，什么时候进入能稳定恢复未见样本的生成区间。它把 Uniform-based Discrete Diffusion Models 解释为一种 associative memory，并用 token recovery 和 conditional entropy 来量化训练样本与测试样本周围的吸引盆。
summary.importance: 这是 diffusion LM 方向里比较值得精读的一类工作。贡献不在于提出更强的模型，而在于给离散扩散语言模型提供了一个可操作的机制解释和诊断框架。AR LM 的记忆与泛化通常通过抽取攻击、n-gram overlap 或下游指标间接观察；这篇论文把问题改写成反向去噪动力学中的稳定点和吸引盆问题。对预训练研究的启发有三点。第一，数据规模不只是降低验证 loss，也会改变模型的吸引盆结构：训练样本的局部盆会收缩，而未见样本附近的盆会扩展。第二，conditional entropy 可以作为 token 稳定性的探针，比只看生成样本是否重复训练文本更细。第三，它说明离散 diffusion LM 的“泛化”可以表现为对未见但来自同一数据分布的序列进行恢复，而不是简单地从噪声中生成新文本。
summary.technical_approach: 论文聚焦 UDDM，即以 uniform corruption 为前向噪声过程的离散扩散模型。模型在反向过程中学习条件分布，用局部条件似然来预测被破坏 token。作者把这种条件似然最大化与 associative memory 联系起来：传统 Hopfield network 依赖显式 energy function 来定义稳定吸引子，但 feed-forward Transformer 一般没有对称权重结构，也不适合强行写成能量模型。论文的关键转向是放弃显式 energy 要求，改用 pseudo-likelihood / conditional likelihood 的动力学视角。简化分析表明，最大化条件似然会隐式产生类似 Hebbian learning 的效应，同时扩大分类 margin，从而在数据点附近形成吸引盆。这个桥接很重要，因为它把离散扩散 LM 的训练目标和记忆系统的恢复动力学接在了一起。方法上，论文用两类探针观察这个结构：token recovery rate 测量被噪声破坏后是否能恢复原 token；conditional entropy 测量模型在给定上下文和扩散步时对 token 的不确定性。低 entropy 且恢复成功的 token 对应更稳定的局部吸引结构。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕训练集大小驱动的 memorization-to-generalization transition 展开。小训练集阶段，模型能较可靠地恢复训练样本 token，但对测试样本 token 不稳定，经常在反向扩散中改写未见序列。随着训练样本数增加，训练点周围的吸引盆不再无限扩张，反而逐渐收缩；同时，来自同一数据分布的测试序列周围开始出现局部稳定区域。进入泛化区间后，模型不仅能保留未被破坏的测试 token，也能从部分破坏的测试序列中恢复 token。论文用 token-level conditional entropy 解释不同恢复行为：成功恢复的 token 通常接近零熵，失败或不稳定 token 的 entropy 更高。sequence-level conditional entropy 则用于检测整体转变；当进入泛化区间后，训练序列与合成序列的 entropy 分布趋于对齐。给出的正文片段没有包含具体模型参数量、语料规模和精确数值表，因此关键应读作趋势和机制证据，而不是可直接外推到 frontier-scale 模型的 scaling law。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 中对 associative memory、memory blackout、generalization phase 的定义，避免把“retrieving unseen data”误读成隐私泄漏意义上的训练集记忆。再看理论部分，重点是 conditional likelihood 为什么足以形成吸引盆，以及它如何在简化设定中对应 Hebbian learning 和 margin maximization。实验部分重点看 Fig. 1、Fig. 2 和 Fig. 3：这些图展示训练样本与测试样本 token recovery 随训练集大小变化的差异。Fig. 4 的 sequence-level conditional entropy 更适合当作诊断指标来读。值得深挖的问题有两个：一是这个 AM 视角能否解释 MDLM、SEDD、LLaDA 等不同 mask/noise schedule 下的差异；二是 conditional entropy 能否在大规模 diffusion LM 训练中作为数据重复、过拟合或泛化相变的在线监控信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when discrete language diffusion models memorize training examples and when they enter a regime where unseen samples from the same data distribution become stable under the reverse denoising dynamics. It frames Uniform-based Discrete Diffusion Models as associative memories and measures the basin structure through token recovery and conditional entropy.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful paper for researchers following non-autoregressive language modeling. Its main contribution is not a better model recipe, but a mechanistic and measurable account of memorization and generalization in discrete diffusion LMs. The associative-memory view turns a vague question, whether the model memorizes or generalizes, into a question about attractors, basins, and token stability. For pretraining, the important implication is that increasing data size can change the geometry of retrieval: basins around individual training examples shrink, while partial basins around unseen but in-distribution examples expand. This gives a more precise lens for studying data scale, memorization, and generalization in diffusion-style language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper focuses on UDDMs, where the forward process corrupts discrete tokens toward a uniform distribution and the reverse model learns conditional token distributions. The key conceptual move is to connect conditional likelihood maximization to associative memory. Classical Hopfield-style memories use explicit energy functions to guarantee stable attractors, but generic feed-forward networks and Transformers do not naturally satisfy the symmetry constraints required by such energy formulations. The authors instead use a pseudo-likelihood or conditional-likelihood perspective: if a model learns to reconstruct tokens from corrupted contexts, the induced reverse dynamics can form basins of attraction around data points. In a simplified setting, the analysis shows that maximizing conditional likelihood implicitly enforces a Hebbian-like update on data points and increases classification margins. Empirically, token recovery rate probes whether a corrupted sequence returns to a given sample, while conditional entropy measures how stable and confident the local token prediction is.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments examine how the retrieval behavior changes as the training set size grows. In the memorization regime, the model reliably recovers training examples but treats unseen test sequences as unstable, often altering their tokens during reverse denoising. As more data are added, the basins around individual training examples become less dominant, and unseen in-distribution examples begin to acquire partial basins. In the generalized regime, the model tends to preserve uncorrupted test tokens and can recover tokens from partially corrupted test sequences. Token-level conditional entropy separates these behaviors: successfully recovered tokens have near-zero entropy, while unstable or incorrectly recovered tokens have higher entropy. Sequence-level conditional entropy is used as a practical transition detector; once the generalized regime is reached, the entropy distributions of training and synthetic sequences align. The provided text does not include concrete parameter counts, dataset sizes, or full numeric tables, so the safest reading is as a mechanism and diagnostic study rather than a scale-calibrated benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it carefully if you work on diffusion LMs, masked language modeling, or memorization diagnostics. Start with the introduction’s definitions of associative memory, memory blackout, and the generalization phase, because these terms determine how the claims should be interpreted. Then focus on the theory section linking conditional likelihood to Hebbian learning and margin maximization. In the experiments, prioritize Fig. 1 to Fig. 3 for token recovery dynamics and Fig. 4 for sequence-level conditional entropy. Two follow-up questions are worth tracking: whether the same basin picture holds for MDLM, SEDD, LLaDA, and other masking schedules, and whether conditional entropy can serve as an online signal for overfitting or phase transitions during large-scale diffusion LM pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你看 diffusion LM 的角度：别只盯 perplexity，要看它是在形成训练样本吸引域还是测试样本吸引域；建议先复现 transition 曲线，再谈范式优劣。
recommendation.en: This changes how to inspect diffusion LMs: stop looking only at perplexity and ask whether they form attraction basins around train or test samples; reproduce the transition curve before making paradigm claims.

paper.title: Why Does Reinforcement Learning Generalize? A Feature-Level Mechanistic Study of Post-Training in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training often improves the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs) beyond the training domain, while supervised fine-tuning (SFT) frequently leads to general capabilities forgetting. However, the mechanisms underlying this contrast remain unclear. To bridge this gap, we present a feature-level mechanistic analysis methodology to probe RL generalization using a controlled experimental setup, where RL- and SFT-tuned models are trained from the

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究一个对 post-train 和 pretrain 接口都很关键的问题：为什么同样从基座模型出发、使用相同训练数据，RL 往往能带来跨任务泛化，而 SFT 更容易引入任务特化和能力遗忘。作者不只比较外部指标，而是把 base、SFT、RL 模型的内部激活对齐到同一个稀疏特征空间，观察训练范式如何改写表示。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析方法和 post-training 动态解释。它对预训练研究的价值不在于提出新的 optimizer 或 loss，而在于给出了一个可操作的表示层证据：RL 的 outcome-level 信号可能不是简单地拟合训练题，而是强化一小组可迁移的内部特征；SFT 则更快写入大量窄域特征。这对 RL pretrain、reasoning mid-train、annealing/cooldown 后接 RL、以及用 post-train 结果反推预训练数据和目标设计都有信息量。量级上，它更像是解释框架和诊断工具，而不是直接提升模型能力的训练配方。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计强调可比性。第一，base、SFT、RL 从同一个基座模型出发，并在相同数据上训练，使表示差异尽量归因于训练范式，而不是数据或初始化。第二，使用 Sparse Crosscoder 对齐不同模型的 residual-stream activation。Sparse Crosscoder 可以看作跨模型版本的 sparse autoencoder：把不同模型的激活编码到共享稀疏特征，再分别解码回各自模型的激活空间。这样可以比较某个特征在 base 和 tuned model 中是保留、增强、削弱，还是新出现。第三，提出三模型 Sparse Crosscoder，将 base、SFT、RL 放入同一个稀疏特征空间，而不是只做 base-SFT、base-RL 的两两比较。第四，引入 Model Attribution Score，用来度量某个特征更偏向哪个模型或训练范式。第五，专门分析 generalization cases：选择 RL 成功而 base 失败的样本，寻找激活差异显著的特征，再通过干预验证因果性。干预包括在 RL 模型中抑制这些特征，以及在 base 模型中放大这些特征。
summary.experiments: 给出的全文内容没有暴露具体模型参数量、训练 token 数、任务集合、准确率表格或干预幅度数字，因此不能补写具体数值。可确认的关键结果有四点。第一，SFT 很快产生大量高度特化的特征，并且这些特征在训练早期就趋于稳定。第二，RL 的特征变化更克制，且在训练中持续演化，同时更大程度保留 base model 的表示结构。第三，在 RL 成功、base 失败的样本上，可以识别出一组较小的 generalization-controlling features。第四，特征干预给出因果证据：在 RL 模型中关闭这些特征会显著降低性能；在 base 模型中增强这些特征，可以带来未见任务上的性能提升。实验强点是从相关性走到了干预验证；需要进一步核查的是 crosscoder 重构误差、特征稳定性、不同层和不同任务上的可复现性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看实验设置，确认 base、SFT、RL 是否严格共享数据、训练步数和评测分布，这是解释结论能否成立的前提。然后读 Sparse Crosscoder 和三模型扩展，重点看它如何定义共享稀疏特征、重构损失、稀疏约束，以及 Model Attribution Score 的计算方式。第三步看训练动态图：SFT 特征数量、专属性、稳定时间；RL 特征增量、演化轨迹、与 base 表示的距离。最后看 intervention 实验，这是最值得深挖的部分。重点问题包括：被干预的特征是否真是推理通用特征，还是某类题型的隐式 detector；放大特征是否带来副作用；同一套特征能否迁移到不同模型规模、不同 reward、不同 RL 算法。建议阅读时间 1–1.5 小时，方法和干预部分需要反复看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why RL post-training often transfers beyond its training domain while SFT, starting from the same base model and using the same data, tends to introduce task-specific behavior and capability forgetting. The focus is not only on external benchmark scores. The authors align internal activations from the base, SFT-tuned, and RL-tuned models into a shared sparse feature space and analyze how each training paradigm changes representations.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a mechanistic analysis framework for post-training dynamics. Its value for pretraining research is indirect but substantial: it gives a feature-level explanation for why outcome-based RL may strengthen a compact set of transferable features, whereas SFT writes many narrow features quickly. This matters for RL pretraining, reasoning mid-training, annealing followed by RL, and using post-training behavior to diagnose pretraining data and objectives. It should be read as an interpretability and diagnostic framework, not as a new optimizer or a direct capability-improvement recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is designed for controlled comparison. The base, SFT, and RL models share the same starting checkpoint and training data, so differences can be attributed more cleanly to the training objective. The authors use Sparse Crosscoders to align residual-stream activations across models. A Sparse Crosscoder can be viewed as a cross-model sparse autoencoder: it encodes activations from different models into a shared sparse feature representation and decodes them back into each model’s activation space. This enables feature-level comparison of what is preserved, amplified, suppressed, or newly introduced. The paper then extends this to a three-model Sparse Crosscoder, jointly aligning base, SFT, and RL models rather than relying on pairwise comparisons. A Model Attribution Score measures whether a feature is more associated with one model or training paradigm. For generalization, the authors isolate cases where the RL model succeeds and the base model fails, identify features with large activation differences, and test causality by suppressing these features in the RL model or amplifying them in the base model.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content does not expose exact model sizes, token counts, task lists, accuracy tables, or intervention magnitudes, so exact numbers should not be inferred. The reported findings are clear. SFT rapidly introduces many highly specialized features that stabilize early in training. RL produces more restrained feature changes that continue to evolve, while preserving more of the base model’s representational structure. On samples where RL succeeds and the base model fails, the method identifies a compact set of generalization-controlling features. Interventions provide causal evidence: disabling these features in the RL-tuned model degrades performance, while amplifying them in the base model improves performance even on unseen tasks. The strongest part is the move from feature correlation to feature intervention. Key details to inspect are crosscoder reconstruction quality, feature stability, layer selection, and replication across tasks or model scales.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the controlled training setup and verify whether the base, SFT, and RL runs use the same data, comparable training budgets, and well-defined evaluation splits. Then read the Sparse Crosscoder and three-model extension, focusing on the shared sparse feature definition, reconstruction objective, sparsity constraint, and the Model Attribution Score. Next inspect the training-dynamics plots: number of SFT-specific features, when they stabilize, how RL features evolve, and how far each tuned model moves from the base representation. The intervention experiments deserve the most attention. Important questions are whether the identified features are truly task-agnostic reasoning features or detectors for a narrower problem family, whether amplification has side effects, and whether the same features transfer across model sizes, reward designs, or RL algorithms. Expect 1–1.5 hours for a serious read.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你看 post-train 的粒度：别只盯 reward 和 benchmark，先复现它的同底模同数据对照，看 RL 是否真的比 SFT 更少写坏 base features。
recommendation.en: This shifts the lens from rewards and benchmarks to representation surgery: reproduce the same-base same-data comparison and check whether RL really damages base features less than SFT in your stack.
